reviews.text: Great location if you stay downtown. Close enough to all the action, but not right on top of it.  Pool was chill, good table minimums, and right next to Pizza Rock which is my favorite.  Make sure to try the Zipline, it was awesome.  Also the Mob Museum.

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: This is a great place, comfortable, well located and with very good staff. If you book it early, it's very cheap. The food is excellent, both in the bar, and in the cafeteria. He would come for a walk and could eat smoothly at the bar or order to take to the room. I recommend it 100%, if I return to Las Vegas, I always stay at this hotel.

reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text: Very nice hotel. Service was friendly and answerd all my questions. Room was clean. Did have to pay extra for a fridge which kind of sucked as when i callee before it i was told it was included. Also the the elevator was not working in the parking garage so that was killer.

reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: The rooms are small but clean! Bed comfy!!would return again! No hot tub but pool was decent. Great friendly at. Casino nice and $2 hot dogs and beer great! Easy check in and out. Ask them to clean room.no refrigerator in the room but no big deal.

reviews.title: Out dated and marked up furniture!
reviews.text: The hotel service desk representative checked us into the old addition tower. I had paid for a king studio suit. The that was displayed on the website was more modern looking.  I had to complain and get them to move to the new update tower. This is something that should have been done at the start. I was not pleased with being given the first room needlessly to say!

reviews.title: Not a happy camper anymore
reviews.text: No one ever came to clean our room and only 2 towels for both of us for the 2 days. I have stayed here several times and my rooms were always complimentary. This time I played more than I ever have and I was only discounted a very small amount. I am very disappointed on how it doesn’t seem like you care about customer service anymore and will definitely look into staying elsewhere..!

reviews.title: We would book it again
reviews.text: Great hotel with good location. Had a large room in the 9th. Floor which also offered a little view. Free parking was great 👍🏻 in the room is unfortunately not a refrigerator, that would have been a must for me with the temperatures outside. Otherwise, nothing was missing. Very fast check-in with friendly staff. Room service / cleaning was only available on request, but did not bother us. You are within 2min on Fremont Street, which you can hear late at night also easily. TV in the rooms has Youtube, Netflix etc...Would sleep there again

reviews.title: Great value downtown hotel
reviews.text: Lovely hotel with great location,just beside Fremont street and right beside mob museum.Lovely size comfy rooms.Great value for food and drink in the on-site bars and restaurants.Good value blackjack that pays 3:2 which is a rarity in vegas these days and they also have $1 blackjack table for those that just want to experience playing without losing the house.The pool area is very nice with good bar service.I would deffo stay here sgain⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.title: Downtown at the Downtown Grand is the best
reviews.text: Staying downtown is so much more relaxed with all the same amenities.  We enjoyed Fremont street and restaurants in the downtown area. The pool was awesome!  We had a great weekend without all the hectic crowds of the strip.  Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Know Before You Go
reviews.text: Been coming here 7 years in a row. Things are sliding. 1st, no house keeping fir 3 days. That means no coffee, no bottled water, no garbage service, you get the picture. We were there 6 days. Yikes.Location is good to Fremont stDealers are hit and miss. Casino bar server at machines is entitled.Go to the El Cortez, you'll be happier.

reviews.title: Downtown train
reviews.text: A really nice hotel. Every facility you could hope for. Really comfy, large rooms. Bathroom excellent.Amazing jazz bar downstairs too, the server there was excellent. They were so accommodating, friendly and cheerful. Great selection of beers and cocktails.

reviews.title: Great hotel, but a noisy environment.
reviews.text: This is a very nice hotel located in downtown Las Vegas. There is a lot of activity in this area at night and so it is rather noisy until midnight.The room condition and cleanliness is superb, and the people are polite and accommodating. There was a rather large line for check in, but they had sufficient to move things along reasonably. I tried to check in on their kiosk, but it would not perform the check in.  I would recommend this place if you were going to be in the northern part of Las Vegas and are not troubled by street noise and activity in the evening.

reviews.title: Good Value
reviews.text: This hotel is priced right and close to what you need downtown. It's far enough from Fremont Street to avoid the noise, but close enough to walk and witness the insanity. This is a DIY hotel. There's not a big employee or security presence. My wife and I were here for 3 days. The room was big and the beds comfortable. We realized there would be no room cleaning service, (they will drop off towels, etc.), no extras and essentially no help. We knew this going in we were fine with it.  It's not the strip, it's the wild west. The bonus here is that Pizza Rock and Triple George are right across the street. If you like pizza, you will love PR. We ate there 3 times and the salads were also excellent. For finer dining, you will enjoy Triple George. The casino here is bare bones, but empty enough to get a table or slot whenever you want.  We gambled elsewhere at Circa, Binions and Four Queens.  The pool and gym are also bare bones. But we experienced both and they were just fine. Staying downtown is better than the strip in many ways. You can visit like 6 casinos in minutes without a taxi. You don't have to walk a mile in an enormous casino to get a bite to eat. On the down side, of course, it's dirty, gritty and lacks the dazzle of the strip.

reviews.title: Needs remodeling
reviews.text: Stayed in the grand towers. The price for a downtown hotel was not bad. Location is good as it is close to Fremont st and many restaurants. On the down side this hotel needs a remodel. Furniture and decor is old, and bed was very worn out and not comfortable. Because of proximity to Fremont and lack of sound proofing your will hear every song played by the band. Bathroom shower is need of help as well. Also no fridge or microwave.

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: Had a suite that I thought had a few perks,but ended up begging for them at the reservation  desk. Had to take care my own trash for four night stay.  Begging for fresh towels and coffee.No one checked on any of my needs thru out my stay. Highly disappointed  on my $1100.00 stay

reviews.title: Pretty good place to stay when doing the Freemont adventure
reviews.text: It's a good place.  My only complaint were the elevators.  It seemed that out of 4 elevators only one operated in a.m. and the other in the evening.  The room was fine.  They claimed in a text just reply  to it for things like water and extra towels.  I did and never got a response nor what I ask for.  The casino was fun despite my luck.  It's clean, cashiers are friendly and the music they played for background was happy in the morning putting me in a good mood.  The variety of places to eat inside but being a block or two from freemont there's plenty of places nearby.  It's right across the street from the Mob Museum as well.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service & very outdated.
reviews.text: This hotel is in need of an upgrade to many rooms. Some might be updated but our was not. One of the chairs appeared to ve frim the 70s ans not at all in a good way. I wish that was all that was wrong. Also, the Freedom Restraurant in the hotel has one of the worst managers that we have ever encountered. Went to have breakfast here one morning and took awhile to get seated but that wasnt the problem... after we were seated we observed some employees running & working hard but saw some standing around drinking coffee (the mgr). Anyway, after we were looking around an employee came up to ask if we needed something. We asked if he was the manager and he said he was. We gave some light feedback and he started arguing with us that he was fully staffed and everything was fine in his restraurant and we just needed to be patient. He was super confrontational to the point that we ended up leaving before EVEN getting food. This manager is running off customers for no real reason. We never did eat at our hotel. Also only 1 or 2 elevators were working in the tower. We definitely wont be staying here again. The Bell stand & doorman stand were very good. Other than that, probably pick a different Fremont street area hotel.

reviews.title: Will come again!
reviews.text: Great spot by Fremont Street! Clean and offers $5 black jack. We enjoyed the food and ease of walking to Fremont. At 11am they offer a $2 hotdog and PBR.  Delicious Pizza Rock is across the street. Pool was decent. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Besides the comfortable bed and pillows, everything was perfect. Drinks were good at the bar. If you have a Caesar's rewards card, bring it, because you can use it at the sport area for betting.I want to thank Jennifer Lawhorn for helping us find the best casino deals, and helping make our stay great. She always responded promptly to emails and phone calls.

reviews.title: Underwhelming
reviews.text: It took me multiple asks to get items from housekeeping then several hours for them to show up. The air conditioner was very loud and clunky. They had a fridge but no microwave, and when I asked they said it was 20$ a night for a microwave. Don’t really care to go back.

reviews.title: Price reasonable, Close to Freemont.
reviews.text: Plus- Close to Freemont Street, Clean rooms,MOST of the staff are very polite, will hold luggage if check-out way before your flight, Quiet from music on Freemont,price reasonable.Negative- Elevators were not working ( we on 15th floor and used Stair well 🥵), everything very expensive, restaurant closes early(can get burger or delivery), No fridge or microwave in rooms, Far ahead reservation with close rooms & get different floors, ASK for your free bottles of water or they are $4.All around not a bad place to stay!!

reviews.title: Clean and handy to Fremont
reviews.text: This hotel is nice and clean. It is very close to Fremont but not noisy at all. We got a continental breakfast included each morning which was a drink.l, cereal/ yogurt , pastry and piece of fruit. We found this more  than adequate for us The down side is housekeeping is only every 3 days. So no new towels or daily water unless you ask for them on the hotel app . We were overcharged at the end by $250 . However I did get this rectified later. But could have done without the hassle.

reviews.title: Last time staying here
reviews.text: The room looked like it hadn't been cleaned in quite a while. There was weird residue that looked like there had been running water on the walls, skiff marks all over the wall, the alarm clock and lamp had visible " gunk" on them. Pubes and hair on the wall in the shower etc.....the reception lady was quite snarky when I had a couple questions such as what time and where the breakfast was, and acted like we should have already know the answers...extremely off putting....I've never preordered the breakfast option here however I have stayed at this hotel approx 4-5 times before and had never had a complaint and really liked the location, however that will be our last stay at that hotel unfortunately. It has definitely moved away from the guest experience.

reviews.title: Toxic fumes in room!
reviews.text: I arrived to find that the room I had booked and paid for some months prior was not available. I was given no explanation for this or any apology.  I was then given a room in the old tower. The fabric of this room very very poor and several of the lights did not work. I asked for another room and was downgraded again to a box room in the new tower with a window up against an outside wall.  By now I was too tired to complain again.  On night 2 at 04:45 in the morning I woke to a strong burning rubber smell. This was coming from the air con unit. I immediately switched it off but the fumes made it impossible to breathe. I had to evacuate the room. To my astonishment reception did not seem to be at all concerned. I said I would be back later in the day and would need to move again to the grade of room I booked and to a safe room. None of this happened.  If you decide to stay at this hotel do not expect to receive the room you booked or any kind of service from the staff.  This goes down as my worst hotel experience and I am well travelled. I was offered no apology or any compensation for my disrupted stay or the downgrade. No one seemed to care.

reviews.title: Clean, comfortable and cute
reviews.text: Loved the downtown grand! Super clean rooms. The casino is clean, well kept and the staff is friendly. The crowd is chill and not the crazy party vegas crowd. The room is quiet and the bed was incredibly comfortable. There's easy access to many food options and there's an awesome rockabilly/jazz club. Free parking is a plus.

reviews.title: 10/10 Recommend
reviews.text: The rooms were modern and it great conditions. It was clean and in a perfect location near Fremont Street. The casino downstairs and pool give you the Vegas vibes without the overwhelming feeling of overcrowding. I would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Average but decent
reviews.text: The pillows are nice but the mattress is uncomfortable. They should upgrade the beds in the rooms. Also, the table games at the casino do not open until 11am during the week days. That’s kind of late in the morning already. Since the casino advertises $5 tables, I would’ve thought they were open in the mornings.

reviews.title: Stay clear. Better options are available for a similar price
reviews.text: A very poor experience from checking in to checking out. I had to wait 5 hours for my room to be ready. In my room the pillow cases were too small for the pillows, not all advertised TV channels were available(not through a pay wall either) and my shower gel ran out after 2 days and I had to daily go to the front desk to get more as they "Don't have any housekeepers available".The breakfast resteraunt didn't allow me to have a table seat on my second morning there, stating I had to sit at the bar/counter as I was solo even though tables were free and available.The hotel really lowered my experience of my trip to Vegas and I will never use the hotel again.

reviews.title: A#1 service, great hotel, perfect location
reviews.text: Concluded my stay today. . .   This is my new downtown spot. Whenever I stay downtown, I'm coming here. . .   Location is ideal. 2 minute walk to Fremont, so you don't get quite as much noise as the hotels right on Fremont. . .  Service was impeccable. Ryan at the front desk was absolutely amazing. Ran into him three or four more times during my stay and he was pleasant and professional and courteous. The ladies, including one manager, who helped me check out this morning, we're just fabulous. Literally everybody I encountered that worked there was great. . . I could not have been more happy with my experience there.

reviews.title: Downtown Grand, best hidden gem on Freemont!!!
reviews.text: This is the first time I have stayed on Freemont, I learned about the Downtown Grand via TikTok, this hotel casino exceeded all expectations from the pleasant and helpful staff, and excellent casino, the pool area had plenty of seating.  The rooms were clean and modern, beds were the most comfortable I have had in a while., and incredibly QUIET. The hotel was in very close proximity to Freemont Street so you have the chance to explore experience.   I would recommend the Downtown Grand to anyone that is going to Vegas, you will be pleasantly surprised!!!!’

reviews.title: Don’t stay here!
reviews.text: Room smells like smoke. House keeping outside of door did not speak English. Called desk and was told we would have to leave our 8th floor room, go to 3rd floor, cross bridge and go to first floor to switch rooms. They would not bring us keys to new room. Carpet and furniture stained and dirty. Mold around tub. Crumbs and dust in drawers. No coffee maker or fridge. Not even a clock. Room on 8th floor, ice on 10th. This place sucks. I have seen better Comfort Inns for less money!  Very disappointing!

reviews.title: Very nice place to stay downtown. The rooms were clean and the pool area was nice
reviews.text: Just a block off of Fremont Street the food was good and the hotel and casino were clean and fun. The pool area is also a huge plus for a casino this size. We could get to everything in a short walk which is the benefit to being downtown vs the strip.

reviews.title: Cool Old School downtown with updates!
reviews.text: The staff was great, the rooms were comfortable and updated with a modern feel. The pool deck was nice with lots of umbrellas and shade that you didn't have to pay for. Free guest parking, and a minute walk to the craziness of downtown. There are swankier, newer and fancier hotels and casinos in Las Vegas, but I thought it was great, and you can't beat the $1 blackjack table. I didn't even know that was a thing anymore in the 2000s. The only reason I didn't give it a five a five was because our room faced a wall that had been painted, so we had no view except for the wall. We weren't in our room a lot, so it wasn't a deal killer, and if you're looking for a place that doesn't break the bank, you could do a whole lot worse. We'll be coming back!

reviews.title: Fun times
reviews.text: Awesome room, great view, very clean and a fun atmosphere. Had a blast down at the tables their staff keeps it fun almost where you feel like you just out playing with friends. Food was good, bummed we were to late for the 2 dollar beer and hotdogs.

reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Everything was awesome but the main level had this weird chemical smell. Not sure if it was from a cleaner or a smoke cover up or what. But it wasn't awesome. Also the shower door was like, half of a door. Is that some weird style? It looked like it was meant to be that way. But water got out for sure. However... Everything else was absolutely fantastic.

reviews.title: Happy with my choice
reviews.text: Stayed in the Gallery Tower.  Check in and check out was a breeze. It was very clean, had comfortable beds, and very good, fast service. I would definitely stay there again. Far enough from Freemont Street noise, but close to get to, only one block.

reviews.title: Great hotel in a good location, but not central!
reviews.text: Excellent new hotel in very good condition and very clean. This hotel is very close to Fremont Street (at the bottom of the same street). The location is a positive but also negative as it is close to Fremont Str. (former center of LV) but away from the Strip (new center of LV and where are the main casinos) and that can only be reached by car or public transport. A positive point is to have a free garage to be able to park during the entire stay. Overall we recommend this hotel but you should have a car for the travel to the Strip and the rest of Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Horrible experience, horrible customer service!!
reviews.text: Horrible experience! Check in was at 3p but flew in around 10:30p just to have front deck tell us they didn’t have the room we had already paid full price for! Me and a buddy made the trip down from Louisiana so we needed two double beds but was given a king instead because “they gave it away”. Then the front desk lady got an attitude with us like we had did something wrong! Very unprofessional! They offered us a rollaway bed, “complementary”, like that was supposed to solve the problem. When they brought it up after checkout it was way too big to fit in the room so my buddy ended up sleeping on a very small chair they had in the corner. Not only did they give our FULLY PAID FOR 2 bed room away, they got an attitude with us like it was our fault. I will never stay at or recommend this establishment to anyone. Hope you enjoyed stealing my money because it will never happen again. 0/0 rating !!!

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: The room was clean, didn’t have any funny smells. The hallways are also clean. Room service took a little long one time and another time they were extremely fast. They need to talk to the Art Bar for closing 29 minutes early causing me to not be able to take advantage of a credit I had with the store on my last day. Really good location with really good food across the street. The Uber and Lyft area is really easy to find and very accessible. Over all it’s a great hotel and I’ll be staying in there new building on the next trip. 😎👍

reviews.title: Unclean Hotel
reviews.text: I will start with the positive. The clerk at the front desk at 2:30 AM was very helpful as well as assistant manager Brett. The water pressure is great. The DJ at the pool was great. Our experience with the actual hotel rooms was horrible. The first room I was checked into was NOT clean and there were bodily fluids on the sheets, scratches on the wall & the bathroom was not clean!  I was moved to a second room that was cleaner. The garage is discussing and NOT attached to the hotel. This hotel has holes in the wall, damaged light fixtures and only looks good online. Major maintenance is needed and a deep cleaning of couches and chairs. We had to order sheets to cover them

reviews.title: What's not to like at this Downtown gem
reviews.text: Excellent stay 2nd year in a row. Boutique smaller property easy to navigate. Friendly employees such as Ryan at check-in,good food deals and an infiniti pool with a view of downtown. Excellent location convenient to the Fremont Experience.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Requested a mini refrigerator time of booking , checked in front desk staff confirmed it said it will be right up I had to call 3 times from my cell phone because phone didn’t work told them no one showed up to fix it and took them almost 3 hours to bring up refrigerator was late for our dinner reservation and show. Parking garage terrible to get in and out of, parking garage was full at night had to go to another garage , parking ticket pass was given didn’t work and garage elevators didn’t work very disappointed it was a nice room but will not stay here again as it was our first time staying at the Grand. Will be staying at a hotel that has a mini refrigerator and a coffee marker in room!!!!

reviews.title: It was a beautiful experience. The hotel was nice and clean. We were only a block away from the Fremont Experience. Nice casino
reviews.text: It was a beautiful experience. The hotel was nice and clean. We were only a block away from the Fremont Experience. Nice casino

reviews.title: Nicer than I expected
reviews.text: When we were leaving the airport asking for a shuttle they said, 'we didn't go down there"  made me a bit concerned but.. the room nice, clean, modern, loved the location. staff were friendly and helpful.. we enjoyed our stay. I do think having a microwave in the room or a stationary one near the registration or cafe would be nice.

reviews.title: Photos added. Nice hotel stay
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for 2 nights. We booked it with the Las Vegas Advisor coupon with no resort fees. The self parking garage elevator was broken (it was on our visit a year earlier).We wanted a room in the Casino Tower, but were told they only open that when the hotel is 80% or above occupancy. They gave us a room in the new Gallery Tower. The room was very clean, but small. The walls are thin, so you can hear your neighbors. We are members of I Prefer, so we got a 1pm check-out. That was nice. The staff were very friendly and I will return. Photos added.

reviews.title: GREAT TIME!
reviews.text: Great Experience! We enjoyed the prime rib special at Freedom Beat. Had a great time at the black jack tables. The staff was friendly and the rooms were very comfortable. The roof top pool had a radio station on Sunday with games and music. We are returning this Saturday for another visit!

reviews.title: We'd come back!
reviews.text: Across from Mob Museum. Not on Strip.Free parking!2 bathroom sinks!Manageable & not overwhelmingNoises: thin walls btw rms, no bathroom fan, Fremont Street in general, & poolside events. Bring ear plugs & eye mask. Hotel lobby smells nice!Art Bar delicious $$ coffee.Affordable Hot dog & burger deals worth eating. Best fries! Thank you, hotel staff!Tip in cash.

reviews.title: bof
reviews.text: Nice Pension but the service is not up to standard: Positive:-- Spacious and comfortable room— fairly well equipped gym— large and beautiful terrace, swimming pool, towel available but closed at 6pm while it is still very hot at this time in the Nevada desert! There is a fountain with ice cubes— very well located— very well soundproofedNegative:-- minimum in the rooms 1 mini bottle of shower gel for 4...— would miss a fridge, kettle - -missing a fountain in the Inn, an ice dispenser given the outside heat— staff reception and breakfast (except Greg who was always very nice) cold and not smiling -- breakfast to 12th: 1 fruit juice or tea or coffee, 1 fruit (apple or banana), 1 small jar of cereal or a yogurt and a very dry pastries from the day before. For the beauty of the Pension it is really not up to it. We had breakfast because we were told on the 1st day that 2 breakfasts were included per room... we made with without feasting to finally learn that it was not included and everything was billed to us!!!— Inn restaurant quite expensive and unfortunate that there is no discount being customer (as in our previous Inn) —-- cleaning done "on demand" except that qd I asked it was not done! What I explained at reception he told me he was going to see to send someone => we went home a bunch of misfolded towel pose to the bathroom and empty towel that’s all, bed not made floor not made ...Review I think it is better to have a smaller Inn but that respects these guests

reviews.title: Never a bad time at the downtown grand
reviews.text: Best bang for your buck in Vegas! This property is clean, new and elegant. One dollar black jack and 2 dollar beer and hotdog? Say less! Never have had a bad time here. The service is absolutely unmatched for a pocket friendly hotel. Room was gorgeous, spacious and CLEAN. even had a microwave and a mini fridge. (One bedroom king suite) Always the best service from the bar staff Jodi, Lena, Augie, Hector, ken, Eli, Pedro, and your speedy waitresses! Michael, Lamar, Sarah and Alicia in slots are SUPERIOR at their jobs! Thanks for a guaranteed good time anytime I walk through the door!

reviews.title: Downtown Las Vegas
reviews.text: Located down town. Service and staff friendly. Had issues with coffee machine and was given a free breakfast. Fremont Street is located close by and within close range to many restaurants. Free parking provided close by. Overall a pleasant stay.

reviews.title: i had a absolute blast my trip was a overall 10-10
reviews.text: i just want to leave a review. regarding my visit to the hotel at first i was very upset cause i booked a room online a smoking room and up on my arrival i told there wasn’t any smoking rooms which had me mad but the young gentleman ROYAL M the Manager i believe was so polite and considerate he was able to calm me down lol and explain to me i was able to smoke in the lobby and when it came time to check in i was slightly confused and he was able to resolve my issue in a timely manner my stay at the grand was very pleasant do to ROYAL M he made sure i was aware of all my accommodations and amenities and i will be staying at the grand again do to his outstanding customer service and then the hotel was so clean and the other workers was also polite me and my sister ice chess broke on us and our beverages fell everywhere idc went everywhere and we laughed with the employee helped us clean it up they all was so polite and considerate i absolutely love the downtown grand and i love the customer service i received from they manager ROYAL M

reviews.title: Stayed at the Luxor B4 and this time was a good experience.
reviews.text: I loved my room ,played golf at Las Vegas National Golf Club, ate at Denny's, went to South Point casino & hotel, walked the strip at night when it was cooler and just enjoyed myself with this solo trip. Looking forward to visiting Vegas again real soon.

reviews.title: All great, but I was harassed
reviews.text: Older hotel, but the room and restroom were clean. Nothing fancy but still comfortable enough to enjoy for 2 days. My floor was quiet and had no issues checking in, getting around the hotel or downtown area. It was good. HOWEVER, one of the employees as I went up the elevator to my room, asked if I was there alone, I said yes, then asked if I wanted company, I said no, then he said what if it’s just for the movement, I said no again, and got off the to my floor. I did not appreciate the harassment one bit nor the comments made. This is where the hotel needs to be extremely strict regarding comments made to guests

reviews.title: A pleasant surprise
reviews.text: Stayed three nights at the Downtown Grand, in the Grand Tower, with one other family member.  The room was clean upon arrival.   The beds were comfortable. A couple minor complaints.   The TV would not shut off, so we had to unplug it.   The toilet took some finessing to properly flush.  We did not ask to switch rooms, but a little annoying.Frankly, I did not know what to expect prior to arrival.   I'd say this resort did the job.   Is it luxury?  No.   Is it dirty?   Nope.   I'd stay here again for sure.

reviews.title: Downtown Grand is grand.
reviews.text: What a pleasant surprise we found staying at the Downtown Grand Hotel. The rooms were beautifuly done. A perk was, handicap parking was comped.  Old school PBR and a Nathans hot dog combo for $3.00. Pizza Rock has delicious pizza.Fun times are to be found here.

reviews.title: First time staying in old downtown
reviews.text: I have never stayed downtown before, always on the strip. It is quite an experience but I probably wouldn’t do it again. The first room we had was right over a bar that rocked until 4:00am, that was unpleasant. However, we moved to the quiet side of the hotel above the casino and really enjoyed sleeping soundly after that. There is tons to do and the Grand is right in the middle of it all. Easy transportation, breakfast all over the place, and walking Fremont Street was a major scene. After staying mainly at the Mandarin or Vdara, the Grand is a more affordable hotel…but you get what you pay for.

reviews.title: Good time!
reviews.text: We always have a great time at the Downtown Grand! Clean and good staff! The rooms are updated and have a newish feel. The location is terrific with lots of coffee and restaurants close by. Easy to enjoy Fremont but also get away from Fremont noise when it’s time to go to sleep.

reviews.title: Meh. Unfriendly and unmotivated staff.
reviews.text: The attitude and demeanor of the two front desk staff we dealt with was less than desirable. At check in, it was clear that the customer was not the priority whereas recognition of their frustration took precedence.We had no shower towels in our room (only hand towels and a floor mat) and had to wait a lengthy period of time for an “available” housekeeper to bring them up to us. The Downtown Grand website advertises and clearly indicates that military and first responder personnel are offered a 10% discount and free upgrade to a premium room. When I inquired about it, they replied that I already received it but their math did not add up to a 10% reduction, nor was I offered the room upgrade.The room cleanliness was decent but nothing worth recommending for the high price point.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: When we checked in we paid for early check in just to walk into someone else’s room. Pretty awkward experience. Also they do not have late check out. Rooms weren’t bad just the experience. No signs saying you can’t use the cabanas at the pool until they try to charge you 400$.

reviews.title: My trips to Vegas and the Grand
reviews.text: The Grand downtown Vegas is a wonderful Casino, and Restaurants. Service is excellent and friendly staff helping You. I also stay there when going to Vegas or just stay before or after flights I'm catching. Always fun. I'm going again in September, can't wait.

reviews.title: Consistently miserable
reviews.text: My third time staying here at the insistence of friends for our annual group trip.  All I can say is “I hate  this hotel so much”.  It’s like they go out of your way to ensure your stay is unpleasant. The rooms are loud, curtains never work (nothing like a morning laser beam of sun on your face at dawn in Vegas). This third trip our room is shoved in a corner on the second floor with a constant booming 24/7.  My friends room has literally no curtain - and was given the same room as last year which had no curtain a year ago. When she complained the response is “there’s nothing we can do”. Despite the fact the place seems eerily empty. We still have 3 more nights here, and I’m dreading it. If I were alone I’d check out early. At minimum I’ve declared my veto power on the Grand and no more Grand for us.

reviews.title: Best of all
reviews.text: Clean, comfortable, quiet and staff was awesome! I had my 3 grandkids with me and I gambled while they enjoyed the excitement of Fremont experience. The Freedom Bar and grill serves excellent food at a reasonable price. The DTG had the most reasonable rates I could find. I’ve stayed there the last 7 times I’ve gone to Vegas! Well worth your money!

reviews.title: Grand hotel Vegas July 2024
reviews.text: Hotel is very niceRooms were new and cleanGreat location with easy walking to nice casual restaurants,Fremont…DisappointmentThe pool closes at 6 o’clock sometimes earlier if they have special eventsBeing here on business, go out to the pool for just a few minutesMinz and Edwin great. Raymond needs some couching Maid service was poor Casino was fun Great staff. Bar tender Bree was greatDisappointment Casino Bella host never returned my calls Never got my credit line set up I was there 5 days

reviews.title: A good place to stay for World Market in July
reviews.text: Beds and pillows were great!  Staff throughout the entire hotel were so friendly and helpful.   Anything we requested for our room was delivered! Will stay here again in January for the world market.   They have shuttle buses and NO lines  for elevators, or Morning coffee

reviews.title: Great service and good value
reviews.text: I was very impressed with this hotel and will certainly be staying again on future visits to the city. Checking in late in the evening was a breeze, with the member of staff being very welcoming and taking the effort to allocate a slightly better room, which for a four night stay was appreciated. It ended up being on the second floor in the newly refurbished tower. The lifts weren’t always the fastest but there’s a decent seating area adjacent on the ground floor.The room was a good size, modern and spotlessly clean. The view from the window was nothing to write home about, being over a concrete wall, but there was some art to admire at least. There were plenty of electric sockets next to the bed, the air-conditioning was effective but a little noisy, the TV was a good size for the room, bottled water and a mini fridge were provided plus coffee machine, all making the space comfortable. The bathroom was also modern with plenty of storage space around the sink. Everywhere was clean and the toiletries were provided in small bottles, but it was a shame that housekeeping didn’t replenish the shampoo and there was no shower gel, only bars of soap.The room was generally quiet, helped by the fact that the property is set back from the Fremont Street Experience so the music and performances aren’t noticeable, but there are notes in the room highlighting the availability of ear plugs being available still. My only criticism would be for the creaky floorboards in the room above - people walking around was very audible and on occasions enough to wake from sleep. Otherwise the room was spot on for the price though.The roof top pool and bar area is a great facility, even though it does close a little too early. Bar staff were friendly, there’s plenty of different types of seating and the atmosphere is great with the music. The rest of the hotel was never overly busy, with the casino area being modern and spacious, plenty of restaurant options and decent artwork throughout.With such a great location in the Downtown area, lovely staff and the modern vibe, I’d highly recommend considering a stay here and it offered brilliant value for money!

reviews.title: Good Place
reviews.text: Check in was quick and easy. Greg was very knowledgeable, and had good suggestions. Lots of dining and entertainment options in close proximity. Room was very clean. Plenty of hot water. Not the best toiletries. The resort fee is kinda a rip for what you get.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: This was our second time here. The location to freemont Street is great lots of restaurants and bars around and easy enough to get a Lyft or Uber to go to strip if you want. The bed's and pillows are comfy and I requested extra pillows and water and room service respoonded right away. You can get a Nathan all beef hot and a beer for 2& at the hotel. We did happy hour at the bar at Freedom and they were delicious and Lena the bartender was amazing!!  The only thing to complain about is there is not enough cocktail servers on the floor for drinks.

reviews.title: Hottest pool in Vegas
reviews.text: Staff was very helpful and pleasant, from front desk to cleaning staff. The pool is not a pool, but the largest hot tub in Vegas. They are pumping warm water into the smallest roof top pool in 100+ weather - the showers were the only relief. If it’s a ploy to get people to buy more drinks that’s terrible. The water is miserably hot.

reviews.title: Failure.
reviews.text: Check in was a nightmare. When I came to the front desk the next morning they still maintained that they had not received my first deposit charged my credit card. After returning later that afternoon to show them my statement where they had received that deposit they finally agreed that in fact, it would be credited my account. as of this moment, which is six hours after I have checked out I have still yet to receive a copy of my statement showing paid in full. This facility does not have their act together. I will never stay here again.

reviews.title: Rooms & Casino Good, Parking Garage Abhorrent
reviews.text: First the bad:Pool: a very small rectangle. Murky. The floors in entire pool area are scary slippery marble. Cabanas: The nicer cabanas (with tv)  face west so any shade completely disappears throughout the afternoon as the sun lowers. Might as well sit in a regular chaise with no umbrella. ***Parking*** Their parking garage nearly ruined the entire trip. No elevator. Yup, you have to circle the ramps on foot, among the traffic, with all of your luggage, kids, etc. There are also stairwells which are narrow, dilapidated and dark. Shower: half-door.  Half of it is open to the bathroom. Water everywhere. Good: They renovated. Casino, hall, and room carpets are clean, looks decent everywhere. Grand Tower: Slightly nicer than Gallery tower rooms. Closer to pool. Less walking between lobby, entrances, casino, parking. Gallery Tower: A tiny bit shabbier than Grand tower rooms. LONG walks to everything from your room. Perk: Exercise room is closer.

reviews.title: Nice hotel in Las Vegas downtown
reviews.text: Nice hotel with a luxurious feel, well organized despite being mega large. Location nice, so close to Fremontstreet. Gym and swimming pool available. Lovely when you need it. Parking nearby, luggage unloading right in front of the door possible

reviews.title: Loved it !! Must come back !!
reviews.text: Very good experience. The Front deck was amazing and accommodating. Areas of the hotel very clean and stocked. I do have a dog and there doggie area was fantastic to use . I left with the intention of coming back and telling everyone to come here as well

reviews.title: Great security!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Grand and never thought we would ever need security until today! The security was amazing. We thought we lost our backpack but instead they held our bag for safe keeping. The lead Macy’s was helpful and kind. So thankful!! Very appreciative of the great service.

reviews.title: You want to stay here
reviews.text: We always stay at this hotel. It’s close to everything, the facility is amazing. The staff is always friendly and the services that are provided are top notch. The machines in the casino are on 24/7, so it’s easy to run downstairs when your significant other falls asleep. Can’t wait to go back.

reviews.title: Hidden gem in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great hotel in the original Las Vegas old town district right at Fremont St. walk to everything.Older style hotel,parking is offsite at a secure park station free in booking. Beware we did have someone try and break into the car overnight so don’t leave anything of value in your vehicle. To far to walk to newer Las Vegas but transport is available easily. Lovely interiors, updated rooms with excellent space and views. Hotel uses deodorant sprays a bit over the top but guess it’s to disguise the odours. Great restaurants onsite, great daily prices for rooms. This place is a great place to stay if you want to be close to all the action at that end of town, right opposite the Mob museum.

reviews.title: Overall a good experience at 'The Downtown Grand'
reviews.text: Just returned from my first trip to Vegas for 12 years . I used to visit regularly and usually stay Downtown (at 'The Golden Nugget') as I like to play the tables and I can't afford the limits on the Strip . I got a good deal at The DT Grand on Booking.com so I gave it a go . I was asked at check in for either a room with a view or a 'quiet' room . I opted for the quiet option . As expected I had a rubbish view but I had heard it can get noisy and I couldn't hear the noise from Fremont . The room was fine . Quite large . I paid a bit more and stayed in the Gallery Tower . I haven't stayed in the cheaper option so can't compare . My only 2 criticisms of the room were that the air conditioner was DAMN noisy (which is kinda ironic considering it was supposedly a 'quiet' room ) and there is no fridge . There is an ice bucket provided and an ice machine by the elevator . Housekeeping is somewhat erratic . I'm still not certain what their policy is . I had my room serviced 3 out of 4 days . I would like to comment that the housekeeping dept were super friendly and only too happy to give me extra coffee and water when I asked . I don't touch the slots . It's a very small casino 'pit' and not many tables . I stayed midweek and it wasn't too busy . There was even a $1 BJ table . There seemed to always be a $5 BJ table available and in the daytime a $5 dice table (my game .) They did put that up to $10 two out of my four nights which I found strange as it was never that busy . They have a 'diner' called 'Freedom Beat' which is reasonable for Vegas . There are PLENTY of decent food options nearby which is a bonus .I didn't use the pool as it was 120 f when I was staying . It looked small but I won't comment as I didn't use it . They have a fairly small gym which I do like to use . It is fairly basic but there's enough equipment in there to get it done .Overall I would recommend this hotel . Vegas has become really expensive in my opinion and if you get a reasonable deal here I'm sure you won't be disappointed . Nothing to do with the hotel but although Fremont St has always been 'sketchy', it's gone downhill . They need to clean out the so called buskers and hustlers . Too many and super annoying . That's no reflection on this hotel though . I will still stay downtown again and maybe here when I return .

reviews.title: Discovered a gem!
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean and quiet room!No smoke smell at all, rare for Vegas, very pleasant experience.  I would definitely come back to this hotel again and recommend to friends and family.The fitness room and pool are conveniently located and clean like the rest of the hotel!

reviews.title: Wouldn't stay again
reviews.text: Truly felt like we weren't wanted there. I don't really make requests of a hotel but here I had a lot of minor to major issues and basically none of them were addressed in four days. We kept getting ignored, dismissed, or just given the run around, and given snark at most turns. I rarely leave reviews for hotels but, I and many others were so frustrated by the end of our stays. The temperature would not go below 73 in the room, basically no matter what. That sucked. Close your blinds during the day completely if you want a manageable cool in the summer. The pool was SO HOT all the time, not at all like other pools in Vegas that have a cooling system. The room was SO loud. Don't stay in the casino tower if you value your sleep as the Fremont Experience stage points right at it. They try to cover it with noise machines in the room but, not super helpful. They say to "enjoy the nightlife experience" but basically you're listening , at a pretty high volume, to whatever is on the stage from 6pm to 2-3am so if you're there for a conference, stay in the gallery tower. You could literally hear it through earplugs and vibrating the springs in the mattress. There isn't an actual fitted sheet on the bed so the bottom sheet was constantly coming up and we were having to rearrange it in the night when I could feel direct mattress under me (gross). I was told there were no fitted sheets and that it doesn't seem to bother other guests when I politely asked them to send one up so I could make the bed. The pool was supposed to be open for a special event for us every day until midnight and yet every staff member had differing opinions on whether it would be (it wasn't 2/4 nights) and we were just told to come home and see if it's open or not and no one at the desk or pool seemed to know if or when it would be open.Our TV went out day one and through multiple calls and texts, after three days of back and forth of them saying they'd fix it, I'm told that it's just some error that isn't fixable and we can switch rooms. I had to ask specifically at the desk about this as every other request was met with silence or a blatant lie about what was happening, or just zero update at all.Our in room phone didn't work, same deal, for days, and I ended up fixing that myself. This felt like a safety issue and I communicated that and was told repeatedly that engineering would be set up to no avail. Our check in kiosk didn't work because it said the room wasn't ready even though it was 8pm, but after a 20 minute line, she said there was a room available and put us into the loudest corner room facing Fremont St. If you have balance issues, the open shower was super slippery as it's a doorless shower so just be careful! The good:The bell people were great, and fast. The room was super clean on arrival and housekeeping was quick and nice with towels, etc. They quickly accommodated us  all to the service elevator when there were issues with the main ones, although thankfully those were working by the time we went downstairs. The room itself was really pretty and the bed was comfortable. They are able to accommodate large groups for events and seem to like that in general. They adapted a lot from the issues we had last year during our main event. All in all, won't be staying here again unless I see some better reviews next time.

reviews.title: A Gem in Downtown Las Vegas: Downtown Grand Hotel Review
reviews.text: My experience at the Downtown Grand Hotel was nothing short of delightful. With its prime location, stylish accommodations, and exceptional service, it's an ideal choice for travelers looking to immerse themselves in the energy and excitement of Downtown Las Vegas. I look forward to returning and exploring more of what this gem has to offer.

reviews.title: Never staying here again
reviews.text: The worst hotel experience I've ever had. The elevators were not working on our tower for most of our stay. We either had to call down to the front desk to come get us in the freight elevator, or use the stairs. Keep in mind we were on the 15th floor, and it was 118 degrees most days. The stairway also had no AC, and had garbage in it. Our first room had a line down one side of the TV, and no ice machine on the floor, plus was extremely loud from the music on Fremont st. The music from outside is really loud until after midnight, so if you're sensitive to sound, dont stay here. We asked to be moved, and the new room was better, despite the hallway being very hot. After a few days the AC in the room stopped working right. We called the front desk and they said they would send somebody up. Nothing changed, so we called again the next day. Once again they told us someone would come check it out, and nobody did. I'm absolutely never staying here again, and if you have mobility issues I don't recommend it. According to the employees, the elevator issue is common.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: The elevator was broken for two days so I had to hope that an employee would be around to take me up to the 14th floor or walk up and down the stairs in the heat. The stairwells are filthy. This rooms in the casino tower lack basic amenities like a coffee maker and mini-fridge. The air conditioning didn’t work in the casino tower so I asked to be moved to the gallery tower, which was an improvement but woke up every morning to my non-smoking room filled with cigarette smoke. There is zero recycling available anywhere in the hotel. I will say that Gregory at the front desk is super nice, professional, and overall very helpful in an extremely challenging environment.

reviews.title: Could have been better
reviews.text: I have stayed here before and really enjoyed it. This  time there were a lot of things that didn't make it the best visit. Elevators weren't working for over 24 hrs and  the garage elevator never worked. We had to wait for someone to get us on the one and only service elevator they had for all guests. The room stayed hot even with a blasting ac we had issues every time we used the parking pass so on multiple occasions my husband had to get a new one which still didn't work, we always needed security to let us out of the garage. The kiosk check in was helpful and hotel location is great. Not a horrible stay but for the price I could have stayed somewhere where elevators worked and enjoyed it much better.

reviews.title: Just give every room a fridge
reviews.text: It really is not ok to run out of refrigerators. I booked in January and requested a fridge but when k checked in there were none available. Just put a fridge in all your rooms! I’m also glad I wasn’t in the tower that had elevators out of service.

reviews.title: Downtown Grand Hotel review
reviews.text: I stayed here for 5 nights in July when visiting Las Vegas for a work trip. My first impression is that the hotel is very nice and clean and somewhat modern. But my review is based on my experience after spending the last 5 nights here (Tue-Sat).My room was 1933 which is in the Grand Tower. Room itself is nice enough and the bed is comfortable. The bathroom has one of those half showers which I loathe. What is the point of having these showers that don’t even block the water from getting all over the bathroom floor? I’m convinced it’s so that you take shorter showers and the hotel saves money on utilities. I seriously hate these type showers as it is definitely not for the guest’s comfort. That being said, the pressure was good and you can choose how hot you want the water rather precisely. My other big complaint about my stay was that every night, there was loud music that you cannot escape from. I put in earplugs and I could still hear the music way too loud. I understand I’m in the “city that never sleeps” but ummm…people still need their sleep and me trying to get my 8 hours of sleep a night while listening to whatever music they decided to play, well it wasn’t happening. I did not get one restful night of sleep because the music kept me up way too late. The rooftop pool has a nice layout with a lot of seating and staff was super friendly and helpful. Overall, the room is nice and clean enough and the hotel is affordable but I don’t think I will ever stay here again based on the shower set up and the loud, incessant music. Staff, however, was wonderful.

reviews.title: Too expensive even if you're just using it to sleep.
reviews.text: Room 1202 Tv doesnt work, called front desk was greeted witha bad attitute and told ticket would be put in. Toilet leaks and has leaked (water stains). Shower glass only covers half and no door so floor gets wet. Toilet doesn't flush correctly.

reviews.title: Don't stay here if you are looking for a good pool!
reviews.text: The property is beautiful and very clean! Very unfortunate that the pool is as hot as a summer day! You cannot enjoy it to refresh yourself on a hot day because the water is so warm that feels horrible! If you enjoy to be in the pool, this is not the hotel to stay. So dissatisfied with the pool staff service (bartenders and cocktail waitresses) and the water being so warm!

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: 1st thing 1st the elevator was messed up had to take the stairs from the 8th floor also, the room was really hot. The AC unit was messed up housekeeping never came to the room to try to clean up. Also never offered any new towels. It was a pretty bad experience.

reviews.title: Pit stop from Ca to Utah
reviews.text: Hotel was clean and staff were pleasant and attentive to any request.  Room did not have soap and shampoo, tracked down cleaning staff and they provided it upon request. Had the $2 hot dog and beer, it was worth $2. Overall good stay and I will stay again.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Hotel is nice. Room was nice; a little dated. Pool area was nice. Workout room was nice. WiFi worked great. Hotel is small enough that you don’t have to walk for 20 minutes to get to your room. Close to Fremont street but couldn’t hear the noise. Parking is an issue. Since they allow the general public to use the lots, spaces fill up with Fremont Street patrons leaving no spaces for hotel guests. One day we had to park on the top floor in the sun. On another night we got back from a show on the Strip and were greeted with a sign that said “lot full.”Had to go to front desk, get a new code for a different lot, just inconvenient at 1am. Overall, our stay was nice. Hotel is clean and staff is friendly.

reviews.title: Great experience!!!!
reviews.text: Everything was amazing- the staff, the room and the bathroom.  It was also near Fremont street, literally 5 min walk l.  It was clean and there was no bad smell.  When you book a ride, the tide also gets there within 5 mins.  I will stay again at this hotel next time I am in downtown Las Vegas

reviews.title: Not a cup of tea
reviews.text: Kiosks check-in are no good, you will have to wait in line since the ID scanning never matches your name. I made the reservation with my full name and it’s same as it appears on my DL. The room designs are ok, the restrooms look basic. The showers need attention, water doesn’t drain properly. The shower handles, stiff enough to say I almost arm wrestled with them. The cleaning definitely needs improvement, the furniture was so visibly filthy (fabric couch and chair). The TVs only worked for half a day, if that.

reviews.title: An undiscovered gem!
reviews.text: From start to end, The Grand did not disappoint. Evan checked me in and provided exemplary care & helped me with a booking mistake (made by me). The room in Gallery Tower was very nice, clean w/a very comfortable bed. The view from the room, 8th floor although obstructed was beautiful. Super close to dining and Walgreens with Pizza Rock right next door.  I stayed here bc nothing else was available but, I found a gem in the process  I will Def. Stay here again, without hesitation.

reviews.title: Not great.
reviews.text: Room was standard. Check in was way less than accommodating. Anytime I offered a solution to solve an issue, I was met with strange excuses like “We don’t have Priceline’s number so there’s nothing we can do.” I do. Let’s call them. “Ummm, never mind we can find the number hold on.” Walks into the back area. Wait another 7 min. “What’s the issue sir?” We are going to call Priceline. “Sir I told you, we don’t have their number.” It was truly mind numbing. Mind you it was 114 Fahrenheit and hanging out by the pool was actual cruelty. I’ve never dealt with such an inhospitable staff at a hotel before.

reviews.title: Good for a quick night stay.
reviews.text: Good for a quick overnight stay. Room definitely needs to be updated. It was like walking back in time. The room was clean and did smell good. Parking was the worst. You need to drop off your luggage at the front door before parking. The parking garage DOES NOT have a working elevator. We ended up paying $20 for Valet because the garage was full and we were not going to walk down and up 10 flights of stair.  AC unit was nosey and the filters were totally clogged up. We had to remove them to cool off the room. Casino was small but did pay out.

reviews.title: Mixed feelings about this Hotel/Casino/Restaurant
reviews.text: I’ve been to this casino probably 5-6 times in the last year, flying down from Seattle. First I discovered the casino and had a great time once playing 8+ hrs straight. Then I started eating here. I usually stay at other nearby Hotels that have better prices/no resort fees. But this time the stars were aligned and i decided to treat myself since I prefer to Gamble, Eat and sleep at the same hotel, if possible. Was going to stay for 3 nights (ended up here for two) Pros vs Cons: Very comfortable beds/pillows/sheets, very clean, fairly spacious, Good A/C, Decent Wi-Fi. I booked on a promo, so it was a reasonable price. One major Con: I had ONE request the entire time I was here. I was running a few minutes late for checkout so I called at 10:15 asking if I could please have brief extension on check out time, hoping for one hour! That’s it. Well, for the first time ever in my thousands of hotel stays, I was denied and told (not untilAfter (Dianne?) asked  for my room number THEN tells me NOBODY is being offered late check out today. (Meanwhile I’m in the lobby now and people are checking out late) So although DG is otherwise a competitive place, this is my second negative interaction with staff in last 5 visits that would’ve been so easy to accommodate a loyal guest and they chose not to. I’ve bragged about this place on Social Media but will be sure people are aware to consider these details when choosing where to stay. The I-Club or whatever they call it is absolutely worthless if they treat you like a Motel 6 guest anyway. (Actually Motel 6 has always taken care of me!)

reviews.title: No Grand Slam Here - It’s a one and done!
reviews.text: Having been to Vegas many times before, this was a quick 2 day trip while we were in between things for our business.  In our shorter stays we like to try out different properties and see if we can add to our short list of favorites that suit different travel needs between work and play. The location of this property in downtown Las Vegas was promising, as were the photos of the rooms and the easy access to things unlike some of the grandiose properties on the Strip that have you walking 20 minutes across the site to simply get to the parking garage. Unfortunately, the Downtown Grand did not deliver.Being in the Downtown area with a lot going on, from over zealous party goers to homeless individuals, on site security and security measures are important.  There was not much of a presence, if at all, of Security monitoring the casino floor or the property.  The scanners in the elevators which are meant to only allow registered guests with key cards to have access to room floors did not work in any of the elevators.  They were simply ornamental, allowing anyone to have access to room floors. Having stayed in other Vegas properties, when these devices have gone down, management has planted security guards at the elevator banks with portable scanners that can read active key cards.  The Downtown Grand took no such measures, nor did they make any mention upon check in that this extra layer was not currently active.  Understandably, traveling anywhere comes with some risk and one must be smart and aware, but when a hotel claims to have measures in place, it’s expected to be the case.Once in the room, overall the condition was tidy and matched the photos for the room we booked.  However, the in person and up close view of the bathroom did not. The floor was dingy with dirt stained grout that looked like it had not been given a deep cleaning in some time, the baseboards did not appear to have been wiped down recently, if at all, and the splatter marks behind the base of the toilet indicated less than basic, let alone detailed cleaning, takes place on a regular basis.  And that was all noticeable from just having stepped into the bathroom…no leaning in or inspection under a magnifying glass required.As for the shower, the hotel opted for a partial glass panel instead of a full door or curtain.  While it offers a clean and modern look, the functionality is terrible.  No matter where you tried to stand or position the shower head, water would escape the shower and soak the bathmat and surrounding floor, posing a slip hazard. And the cleanliness of the shower matched the rest of the bathroom, with built up “muck” in the corners of the shower floor/trim.Having decided to give the Downtown Grand Hotel a try for the first time to see if it might become part of our regular rotation of hotels when we’re in town, it is safe to say that it will also be the last time.  Given that it missed two of the top three things I look for in a hotel (location, security and cleanliness), it will be a one and done for us and this property.

reviews.title: Outstanding Security and Staff - Highly Recommend!
reviews.text: During my recent stay at the Downtown Grand Hotel & Casino in Las Vegas, I had an unfortunate incident where I accidentally dropped my wallet while playing the slot machines. To my dismay, someone took advantage of the situation and removed $810 from it. Thankfully, the quick and professional response from the hotel's security team turned what could have been a nightmare into a positive experience.Marcus and Brian from the security team deserve special recognition for their exceptional efforts. They swiftly reviewed the casino's camera footage, identified the individuals involved, and coordinated with their colleagues to locate my wallet. Their diligence and efficiency were truly impressive.Moreover, the entire staff, from security to the cleaning crew, went above and beyond to assist me. They helped me retrace my steps, ensured I didn't overlook any potential spots where my wallet might have been misplaced, and eventually recovered both my wallet and the stolen money.I am immensely grateful to Marcus, Brian, and the entire team at Downtown Grand for their outstanding professionalism and dedication to guest safety and satisfaction. Their prompt action and thoroughness made a stressful situation much more manageable. I highly recommend this hotel not only for its amenities and services but also for its exceptional staff who truly care about their guests' well-being.

reviews.title: Locked outta room dead battery
reviews.text: Got locked outta my room at 2:30am. Went to the front desk twice to change the key since I was unable to gain access. Ended up asking for assistance. After 2 failed attempts myself. Having 2 different employees having to  help me out and the engineer had to come back and forth twice since he didn’t have the proper tools. Turns out that the battery died on the key censor. Took a whole hour to get into my room. :( they did end up giving me an hour extended check out but not as a solution to the problem only becuz I asked for it

reviews.title: Freemont Fun!!
reviews.text: Beautiful and clean rooms.. the bed and pillows were excellent.  The noise from Freemont street was loud but that's beyond their control.  Earplugs do help!!! The access to Freemont street was amazing, best people watcin6for sure!! The Casio had a awesome and fun vibe... we will definitely stay again!!

reviews.title: Totally decent.
reviews.text: Overall, not a bad hotel. Small cozy location right off Fremont. Safe area. Friendly staff. Casino not huge but has multiple entrances and is cozy. Stay in the gallery tower, newest edition of the building. Ride share access, parking and valet is more accessible than most places in Vegas. The $2 Nathan's hot dog Pabst blue ribbon beer deal is the probably the best deal I've ever had anywhere. The included centennial breakfast at the Artbar is a pretty good deal too. Sportsbook is easy to make bets in. Casino has good drink service (being smaller has a plus). The elevators could be cleaner and my biggest criticism is  pool area, it  has potential, but needs some upgrades. Gallery rooms and hallways are clean, however the bathroom floors could use more attention. Also, hotel rooms need bigger trash cans (all hotels).  More people should stay here, but I understand why many may choose not to.

reviews.title: Great Vegas experience
reviews.text: It was an  Excellent  room, in a great location away from busy strip, and the check in girl (Lindsey?) was so nice, great experience and decent price. We had a  Beautiful view of downtown and Fremont street. The bed was nice, the room was very new and clean, and the hotel was very to close to Fremont street

reviews.title: EXCELLENT SERVICE BY BELLA RODRIGUEZ AND ALL STAFF!
reviews.text: I HAD A GREAT TIME AT THE GRAND! EVERY STAFF MEMBER GAVE EXCELLENT CUSTOMER SERVICE!! ESPECIALLY OUR HOST BELLA RODRIGUEZ, WHO WENT ABOVE AND BEYOND TO MAKE OUR STAY PLEASANT!! SHE WAS AWESOME AND IS SUCH A GREAT ASSET TO THE CASINO HOTEL! LOOKING FORWARD TO OUR NEXT STAY THERE!! THANK YOU BELLA YOUR AN ANGEL!!👼

reviews.title: Would recommend!!
reviews.text: What a great stay!  Room was clean and huge! (King suite-was a corner suite- Gallery Tower) Used the app to request more towels, etc and had them at our door in 20 minutes!  Easy access to Fremont Street-still had some noise-but to be expected with location/street/vehicles etc.  Was on third floor (pool access) so did have some noise from floor above.  Ate at Freedom Beat -great service and food!  Only “complaint” is that wish the pool was open longer-closes at 6-which after a long day out and about-would be nice to have more time to relax!  Would stay/recommend again!!

reviews.title: Amazing 9/10
reviews.text: The best pillows ever! This hotel is just far enough from downtown to still get some sleep. Rooftop pool is nice. Great location,free spot play, 2$ hot dog and beer, 7.77$ burgers from 10pm to close at freedom beat, etc. What’s not to love about this place ?

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: Hotel was fairly clean. The bartenders are super friendly and most of the staff as well. But I was disappointed that our toilet seat was busted and would not stay on the toilet, the safe was broken, the window curtains had the last few feet ripped off and hanging there. When I brought this to the attention of the hotel staff, they really could have cared less. I wont stay here again, but I would visit the bar or maybe do some gambling.

reviews.title: Hospitality business
reviews.text: Beds comfy old no micro/fridge staff on both casino and lobby are rude and have no customer hospitality pool closes super early and the shade is for the Rich or for the staff it's outdated and advice can you pls buy one huge umbrella for the middle beds casino waitress are super rude blonde headed lady  was mad as soon as she got in to work messed up whole vibe close to strip and free of noise other than staff it's was 4/10

reviews.title: Exceeded Expectations
reviews.text: Staff was exceptionally friendly, including the 1st shift (morning) craps dealers on 6/6/24 who were friendly & helpful.Room was clean, towels soft as a cloud, bed comfy. I found the thermostat settings quirky. The A/C would cutoff after a period. Probably something I could've rectified myself but it wasn't that much of an inconvenience. I would simply restart the system and the room would cool in just minutes. My only complaint was the inoperative light in the makeup mirror I don't wear makeup so again, no big deal.Loved the $2 hot dog & drink deal. The pool was nice. I thought it odd that the pool waitress never checked with me to ask if I wanted anything. I had no problem walking to the bar to get drinks for myself. She missed out on the tips I would've given her, in part because of the extent to which her swim-attire added to the scenery.My chief complaint was the fact that the casino lacked any Jacks or Better video poker machines except perhaps those at the bar. I mentioned it to a guy working on a machine with a technician on the floor. He agreed that the floor lacked the game but promised they'd be available soon. I told him a casino without JoB video poker is akin to a McDonald's without cheeseburgers.I limit my casino play to JoB video poker and craps. I love playing $5 or $10 minimum craps at the Grand but was forced to head over to the Four Queens for VP.Note to Downtown Grand casino management: please make full-pay (9/6) JoB available so I can get both my craps and VP fix addressed under one roof: your roof.I will stay at the DG again next visit because I don't have a good enough reason not to.

reviews.title: Vegas 2024
reviews.text: The one bedroom gallery suite was wonderful!! Comfortable bed and great pillows. Anything we needed we called down for they brought it right to the room. We be staying there again when we get back to Vegas. The 2.00 hotdog and a beer was the best quick lunch around.

reviews.title: NOT pet friendly
reviews.text: This is NOT a Pet friendly hotel. When i went there the parking elevator was broken and i had to go 3 floors with my studs and my cat, after i check in they said cats is not allow.I told them that web says is pet friendly but they said “but not cat”What it’s means?? Cat is not a pet? My cat have all the papers!They should say “only service animal” I had to go upstairs to the parking lot with all those things with NO ELEVATOR!!

reviews.title: Wish it was better
reviews.text: I was definitely excited , but right upon arrival I quickly became disappointed. While checking in I was told the room I booked online was no longer available “ which makes no sense due to me already paying for a room “ and I ended up paying more for a room lower than expectations and window which my only view was a wall right up against it . My bathroom spelled like urine . I parked my car into the structure across from them , when doing so the guard let me know that they were supposed to give me a parking pass at check it and that they seem to always fail to offer there customers the pass . Just overall disappointed in the stay ! But hey no bed bugs right

reviews.title: bad experience !!!!!
reviews.text: Stayed here for a family event. But when we checked in and saw the room, we were disappointed. The bed sheets  are full of stains, the walls have scratches, carpets are worn out (we asked for new bed sheets). There's no even a remote in the room. As much as I don't want to blame anyone here but I wish they do their jobs next time. Even the sink is clogged, the pillows are disgusting because of stains, asked for extra pillows from the front desk twice but didn't gave me those request. me and my boyfriend just sucked it up because we're just staying for few days and we are always out of the hotel. Had no time to complain to the front desk because we are in a rush and we only have little bit of time here. I was also charged $650+ when I only paid $500+ from booking.com. Checking out tomorrow and will talk to front desk about these problems.Update: I talked to Tania from front desk about my concerns in the room. Good thing she was nice that she took note of my problems. But when I have to grab my other stuffs from the room they locked me out when it's not my check out time yet. I came down to front desk to get help, but when I came back to my room the key card didn't go through. Had to wait 30 mins for other teams to help me. I never liked my experience to be honest. Damaged rooms. Lots of inconveniences. And the other staff I talked to on the phone to ask help about being locked out and have to grab my things gave me a sassy voice. LOL at this woman. I hope this hotel improves everything.But shout out to Tania from front desk who was very nice. Except to the other woman I talked to on the phone, she's lucky I forgot to ask for her name.

reviews.title: Try it You’ll like it
reviews.text: Really nice hotel. Room was clean and well appointed. Freedom Beat food was great service was excellent and prices were reasonable. It’s a small hotel with great service. Not a single complaint out of the 20 or so rooms our crowd had rented. Would definitely stay here again. Casino needs more 3/2 blackjack tables.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: The room still smelled like cologne of the people who stayed before me even after 3 days. Trash was still in the room from previous guests. Lindsey at the front desk was amazing and had great customer service. Sink drained slowee but quick fix.

reviews.title: Third visit - we’ll be back!
reviews.text: This was our 3rd year staying at the Downtown Grand for the Punk Rock Bowling festival. We love this hotel, they work with the festival folks to play the right music, theme the hotel, and use the hotel pool for pool parties. Staff are awesome both at the front desk as well as casino staff. We love the craps crew. As part of the hotel package we got match play tickets which we used on the pass line and doubled our money. Complimentary drinks came pretty regularly at the craps table. Craps is $5 minimum for some of the day and $10 at peak times. There’s a $2 hot dog and beer special that runs most of the day. Rooms are fine, clean and comfortable. It’s not the quietest hotel, you can definitely hear the stage on Fremont st, and Hogs & Heifers bar, and whoever is playing at the pool, but it didn’t interrupt my sleep.

reviews.title: nice location....
reviews.text: not noisy from fremont & only a block away--great restaurants across the street along with the mob museum--they have a $2 beer & hotdog special until 6pm--they are filling up the gambling room with low minimums for playing..beautiful hotel with a gorgeous pool area....

reviews.title: Nice bang for the buck
reviews.text: The hotel was very clean and the staff were highly efficient. I would definitely stay again if in the area. Their proximity to Pizza rock and the Fremont experience are ideal.                      The only issue was the elevators were malfunctioning and it took a very long time for them to come. And when they did come they acted very peculiar and at times we were unsure if we were going to reach our desired floor. It led to an opportunity to laugh with our fellow hotel guests and ultimately we did arrive safely on the right floor.

reviews.title: My Las Vegas downtown grand hotel experience
reviews.text: The room was very clean and the air conditioning worked very well and that helped because it was very hot and sticky my only complaint is the TV was broken there was only static we told that front desk and said that there was nothing they could do about it which didnt help because we had 2 younger nephews

reviews.title: Sucks
reviews.text: The elevators were inconvenient only 1 working. I asked for a DND sign from housekeeping never received one .. I asked for extra towels didn’t get them it was a few guests that were stuck inside of the elevator for 45 minutes. I will not never return back ..

reviews.title: Amazing  place
reviews.text: This is not my first time. Just like my previous stay I love the hotel, Casino, pool, staff and rooms. I highly recommend booking a trip here! You will be happy! Great location and overall vibe. I’m not a fan of having to write more with this review though lol

reviews.title: Would definitely stay here again.
reviews.text: Would have gotten 5 stars but only one elevator working majority of the weekend on arguably one of the busiest weekends in Vegas made it annoying but overall everything was great. The $2 pbr n hotdog combo can't be matched in Vegas!  They are atleast 6-10 for JUST the Nathans hotdog on the strip.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: I know there was nothing staff could do but we booked because of the pool in the photos and to just to relax before the flight in the morning. I understand no early checkin was available so we walked around till 3pm, went to checkin and no rooms available, had to downgrade almost 3hrs later by the time we finally got our room keys it was 10til 6pm which apparently is when the pool closes., The rooms only look like the pictures at certain angles Motel 6 has better rooms and better restrooms, for what we paid it was a waste. Like i said tho i understand there was nothing the staff could do since it was overbooked. And they were doing the best they could, but will never ever stay at that hotel again.

reviews.title: Perfect downtown hotel!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Downtown Grand.  This is a great location if you are attending an event at the World Market Center like we were.  Our son had a cornhole tournament and we walked every day to his events.  The weather was hot and sunny so we enjoyed the beautiful infinity pool every day.  Our room was clean and spacious, the pool food and drinks were awesome.  This is our new go to hotel when we want to be near Fremont St. but still get a good nights sleep.

reviews.title: Enjoyable stay
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay very much. Great location one block away from Fremont Street. The hotel was very clean > my room, the casino, the pool area. The pool was very nice. It was never crowded and I could always get a lounge chair. I ate twice at Freedom Beat; both times were good. Staff was friendly and professional. Will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Value And Convenience In Downtown Las Vegas
reviews.text: Went to LV for a birthday trip to see my favorite band’s residency.  You can usually find better deals in Fremont St/Downtown.  The Grand has a pool deck, inexpensive gaming, and solid restaurants.  It’s conveniently located to other options, casinos, Mob Museum, and the Fremont St. Experience. as well,

reviews.title: Worst stay ever
