reviews.text: I have never been so disappointed in a hotel stay. I arrived at 1030 from a delayed east coast flight and I was exhausted. I did the kiosk check in as I was encouraged to do so via text. In the elevator I overheard a porter mentioning that he was moving a woman to another room because her walls were shaking from the pool party. I got to my room on the 9th floor and it was worse than I imagined - the walls shook, even with earplugs I could distinctly identify the songs. I called the front desk and asked if I could be moved and she flatly said no and that the pool party would be done in an hour. No apology, no warmth, no kindness. I was so tired and had a 6am work call so the only quiet place to sleep was on the floor of the bathroom with the bed pillows. When I called the front desk to request new sheets and when she asked why, I explained I slept on the bathroom floor, and again the person did not apologize, was not warm, was not kind. She just said I’ll have housekeeping change the sheets. When I went downstairs to the front desk and asked about additional parties the next nights, I was told there were daytime pool parties that would be done by dark. When I calmly explained how loud it was and how I slept on the bathroom floor, again no apology, no warmth, no kindness. When I asked if I could receive some sort of compensation for the night before, without looking me in the eyes, the woman at the front desk quickly offered me a $40 room credit. Then when I tried to use the pool before the pool party I was told it was closed due to the party. For the price, the rooms are sparse - no fridge, no microwave. When I ran into the housekeeping staff, she asked if I didn’t need anything in the room which tells me that the front desk did not tell housekeeping to change my sheets.I have never hated a hotel stay in my life. I’ve stayed in Vegas at many other hotels and I’ve never had such poor soundproofing or such rude unkind staff members. If it was just one rude staff person, I’d think they had a bad day. But an entire rude front desk tells me management is poor and doesn’t treat their employees well. Having worked in the service industry before I’ve only ever left one poor review in my life and now this is the second. I would never ever recommend this hotel to anyone. There are better hotels in the area at comparable prices with better amenities. The pool was fine and small. There’s no room service and the cafe closed at 3 so if you needed anything there were vending machines. Another reviewer put it best - the most unwelcoming hotel.

reviews.title: Went with a group of friends.  Was our first experience staying in old town.  WE LOVED IT!!! DTG is the place to stay
reviews.text: Went with a group of friends.  Was our first experience staying in old town.  WE LOVED IT!!! DTG is the place to stay

reviews.title: Always a Perfect Stay
reviews.text: Always a perfect stay. I have been to other Hotel and Casinos and this one gives you the best bang for your buck. Close to Fremont, but not too close. Low resort fees, $5 blackjack and many other specials. The staff is professional and courteous.

reviews.title: Great Room but the Noise was Unbearable!
reviews.text: We stayed in the gallery tower and had a very comfortable room that was clean, updated and well furnished. We would have slept well if it was not for the loud music from the pool that went on late into the night. We also had two barking dogs in the room next to us that the owner obviously left alone in the room.  We had looked forward to enjoying the pool but again, the loud booming music made it impossible to work, talk, read or relax so after two attempts at the pool, finally gave up and went to scope out other hotels for next visit.

reviews.title: DISREGARD FOR GUESTS CONCERNS & COMPLAINTS
reviews.text: I am a travel advisor with clients that requested and booked a stay for a few nights at the Downtown Grand Hotel (Mar 28th to Apr 1st).   Upon arrival my clients were a bit blindsided by the amount for the incidental hold (but was reassured the amount would be returned in a in timely manner after the check out date). They also noticed the escalator was out of order and was given no warning of this before arrival.  The hotel staff seemed to have no clue if or when it would be fixed.  My clients also experienced a strong stench of urine through out some areas of the hotel.  My clients expressed their concerns and disappointment with the front desk and was told no compensation would be given.   This booking was made with a 3rd party and I reached out to them for assistance with this complaint.  After quite a few unanswered inquiries, a response was finally given in which the hotel refused to acknowledge the complaints or offer any compensation to my clients.  My clients also had to call the hotel days after their return to inquire about the return deposit from the incidental hold.  I can't say enough how disappointing, frustrating, and disrespectful it is for an establishment to treat it's guests this way.  Needless to say, I have told fellow travel advisors about the conditions and poor customer service provided by this hotel, and will never refer this hotel to future clients.

reviews.title: This place sucks
reviews.text: This place sucks - you can’t check in early without a fee (which was 50% of the rate I paid for my room, and I had one of the expensive Gallery tower rooms). Pool was ‘closed to set up an event’ when I was there. But I checked and it was fully set up at 10 am when I wanted to use it. Pool staff  were super rude, I would never stay here again.

reviews.title: Hotel experience
reviews.text: We had the best experience not only with Las Vegas but with the hotel hospitality overall.. everything and everyone was so nice and friendly I just can't get over the best time we had. Planning to come back real soon and when I do I definitely will stay with this hotel again.

reviews.title: Not bad!
reviews.text: Not bad at all. Clean rooms, nice pool (although looking a little tired), friendly staff and cheap blackjack.Close to the Mob Museum and Fremont Street (5 minutes to the ABC) store. I would definitely recommend it for a stay. Food is fairly good & there are a few cheaper options close by.

reviews.title: Great corner suite in the new tower.
reviews.text: Checked in May 4th early. Got to the room and no remote for the TV.  After several attempts and miscommunications Security Supervisor Brian Snell made a special trip to our room to bring us one. Very helpful and friendly.   Had a great time and a corner suite in the new tower. Beautiful room.

reviews.title: Grand bust
reviews.text: I always loved the grand but I didn’t get room service and the water was out . When I told her at ck out she said it’s on now . Didn’t offer me any compensation . Very poor service .went to pool, it was roped off for a party on the next day all I heard was banging for set up , very loud and rude not to accommodate the guests there!

reviews.title: Thank YOU Royale!!!
reviews.text: Royale at the front desk is soooo professional, knowledgeable, annnnnd helpful; this was my second stay at this hotel he provided the same superb customer service!! Royal definitely made me feel like ROYALTY!!!! Oh and my room didn't disappoint either!!!

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: The service was great checked in fabulous room its one of the best hotels we stayed in on our american trip! Our room didn't get serviced so asked reception why? they only do it every other day okay i said but when we got back that evening housekeeping had been they came again the next day. We also liked that we could get a beer & a hot dog for $2 bargain.

reviews.title: Quiet quaint Hotel, just off of Fremont  Street
reviews.text: This hotel was wonderful. Upon checking in we mentioned that this was a family get together that was way overdue. It had been six years since we had been to Vegas, and we used to go up to 2 times a year, so I wasn’t sure what to expect. The person checking us in, Andrea, happily listened to how  excited we were to be back, and graciously upgraded us to a suite in the Grand Tower on the 26th floor!The Suite was beautiful, and was perfect for family gatherings. We had so much fun during our stay. The Freedom Beat restaurant on site had the best prime rib for $14.99 (with player’s club coupon received after earning 25 points in a day.) Our server, Olma, was wonderful and we made sure to ask to be in her section  when we returned the next evening.The coffee shop by the check in area made great specialty coffees, and had a nice selection of assorted pastries. The $2 beer and hotdog offered on the casino floor was perfect for a quick snack.We also would like to give a special shout out to the players’ club signup personnel. We signed up around midnight. The next day we went for a piece of pizza directly across the street at Pizza Rock. There was a stack of cards set up in a display next to where we were paying, and it said $15 free slot play for new player card members at the Grand Casino. What we did not know was that, to get the free slot play, you had to present the card upon signup. Since we had signed up around midnight the night before after Pizza Rock was closed, we didn’t  know about the free slot play. We thought we’d ask about it. The gentleman at the players card desk informed us of the requirement, but then made a call to the higher ups, and they allowed him to add the free slot play retroactively to our cards! I thought that was really nice of him to go out of his way and check for us.The casino is a little small, but comfy. It wasn’t tight either. My aunt won around 2k, my mom hit a royal flush on VP, and I broke even. So I would say that is a big win for us in the casino! Overall we had a wonderful time at the Downtown Grand, and can’t wait to go back!Many thanks to all the staff at this hotel for making our visit a memorable, fun, and enjoyable experience!

reviews.title: Great hotel and great location!
reviews.text: They made everything easy… from the location, food, check in to parking! Within walking distance of all the nightlife! We will definitely be staying here again.

reviews.title: Best time ever!
reviews.text: Loveeee this place. Our favorite place to stay. We dont care for the strip so staying on fremont street is wayyy better .Coming back in November ! So many good things happened this trip. We renewed our vows,met someone off of a favorite TV show. It's been epic.

reviews.title: Good gambling and staff, ok accommodations with a lackluster pool
reviews.text: Where do I begin…the staff is great! We were so welcomed by everyone so it’s definitely got that going for them. It’s so hard to find genuine service in LV and it is very much appreciated that the Grand focuses on that. Perfect location because it’s not on Fremont and they have a safe plaza to walk directly there. I absolutely loved the location! The staff also does a great job at keeping non-customers off property. The pet accommodation was satisfactory. They provide a very nice, small dog park that is close to the new side of the hotel. The carpet in the room was soiled so unfortunately my dog had to stay in her crate for the one-night stay. It was actually dirty enough that I didn’t want my own dog walking on it. I also had dirty socks after walking around the room, and that was very telling to me about how the housekeeping is run. This being said, the hotel is very spread out, hodge-podge in design, and overall inconsistent. It has obviously been piecemealed together over the years, and it can be very confusing and awkward to navigate. Only one elevator would be working out of a batch, making the wait for elevators long any time of day. The pool was…not newsworthy. I just kinda walked in and walked right out. The pool itself looked cool as it is a 360 infinity edge pool and you typically have to pay extra for that on the strip, but the furniture and cleanliness was very unsatisfactory. They need to address this. I noticed that the Grand has been open for 10 years now, has that furniture been out there the whole time? The parking situation here is very uncomfortable. You are to park in one of two garages that are not connected to the hotel. It appears that this is customary in the downtown area, but it really was an inconvenience. They offer a nice valet, but if you choose to self park, there is a ticket process through the front desk (inconvenient) and you need an access code to get back into the garage because it’s downtown and everything is locked. Our access code did not work for either garage when we self parked. The elevators were not clean and it was a very unsanitary area. I would recommend the garage immediately across the street from valet/drop off. It’s about the same in cleanliness, but it’s a much shorter walk. They have an ok gambling floor. Offering the only $1 blackjack you can probably find, this was probably the nicest pit we encountered this trip. Very friendly dealers and the pit boss was so chill. Slots were not too greedy and I got a couple pays! Overall it was satisfactory and I enjoyed gambling there. I loved the $2 PBR and hot dog stand, please never take that away! We heard a lot of people mindlessly complaining about the hotel, but about dumb stuff like the DJ down the street or people being belligerent outside at 4 in the morning. But these are actual concerns of mine (parking, overall cleanliness, pool, lack of connection to other parts of the hotel and garages) and I think this hotel misses the mark on several integral amenities and conveniences, especially in LV. After checkout, I talked with my spouse and we both agreed that the expectation was higher than what we received. Thank you for the friendly staff!

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: Rooms were fine, bar service not so much. Setting at bar playing video poker. No service until the I was out of credits. Then denied a drink until I put more money in the machine,

reviews.title: Downtown Grand Sucks
reviews.text: The staff was rude, unprofessional and unaccommodating!Also having to listen to the DJ from Fremont Street thump and bang on what was way to much bass till 2am sucked. I would never in a million years recommend this place to anyone not even my enemy.

reviews.title: Always A Pleasure and Always Fun!!
reviews.text: I do a stay cation once a month, and I always stay at the Downtowner.   It's a lovely little place.   24 hour bar that also serves as hotel check in.  The rooms are upgraded and so comfy.  The linens are soft and very clean, the bed is so wundyful that I don't move during the night.  The towels are new and fluffy and the water pressure is spot on!!!  It's right off Fremont Street,  within walking distance to tons of bars, casinos and restaurants. The staff, however,  at The Downtowner....let me say this....they make you feel so welcome and at home!!The manager,  Tamara, is professional and very witty, and she is the epitome of customer service.   Her assistant, Dee and AJ, are warm and courteous.   They ALWAYS remember your name too.Frankie, Leslie and Shaq round out an incredible staff.  I truly feel like family here and I highly recommend staying.

reviews.title: DOWNTOWN GRAND HOTEL WILL STEAL FROM YOU!
reviews.text: DOWNTOWN GRAND HOTEL LAS VEGAS WILL STEAL FROM YOU!!  On a recent 3-day stay at the downtown Grand hotel, they stole $118 from my credit card.  The room was already paid for in full,  including all fees and taxes, through priceline.com.  they forced me to give them a credit card for a security deposit or else they would not let me check in.  They then robbed me of $118 even though it was supposed to be a refundable security deposit.  Bottom line, downtown Grand hotel will steal from you!  You have been warned...

reviews.title: very limited chairs to use at pool .
reviews.text: very limited chairs to use by the pool. we pay a high mandatory resort fee but couldn’t lay down on a chair. there were many chairs by the side but you have to rent space to sit on chair.   abusing ve to pay more money when no one is using chairs. only one server taking orders so we never had a chance to order drinks.

reviews.title: Great restaurants, comfortable rooms and a nice atmosphere.
reviews.text: This was our first stay at the Downtown Grand. We decided to try something new and we all are happy we did. We will be back, this is our new go to place!!We did have a situation with a drink waitress Raynell, she was awful and rude.  Also there was a drink waitress at the pool that was awful and rude. Jamie the bartender at the pool was very nice.   Dee the bartender at the fat cat was very nice also.But you can't let two bad apples ruin your vacation.We will be back!! Can't wait till next time!!

reviews.title: Very nice!
reviews.text: Great suite upgrade!  It had a separate living space , mini fridge and 2 bathrooms.  Very clean room  and comfortable bed and we loved the sound machine.  We had lunch at Triple George - it was very nice and good food.  This hotel is close to the Fremont Experience.

reviews.title: Clean your carpet!!
reviews.text: Had a beautiful King suite with city views but the carpets were filthy  my wife had on white socks and the bottom of them were black after only a few minutes in the living room area.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: First time at DTG - excellent , not as large as the Big Casinos Stayed in the tower , room seemed new , lifts were excellentWould recommend to everyone , next time in Las Vegas will definitely stay at DTGFreemont Street gets busy but you wold know staying here

reviews.title: Helpful and Kind
reviews.text: Samantha at the front desk was very helpful and professional.  She got me checked in quickly with no issues.  She was kind and pleasant to speak with.  I also had some perishables with me and she made sure a fridge was sent to my room.  Other than the noise outside my room on the first night, my stay was pleasant.

reviews.title: Friendly staff, clean rooms, good vibe in casino, mediocre food at Freedom- Beat Cafe
reviews.text: 4 nights with friends, check-in and out easy with kiosk service; check-in on line for kiosk access. Be sure to provide your cell phone number on your reservation so you will get a link for pre-check-in! Skip the line at the front desk and get your room keys directly from the kiosk!Casino was friendly and fun! Craps, Roulette, Black Jack, Holdem’ & 3-card poker and all the latest slots. Gourmet Pizza and Upscale Steakhouse right across the street, steps from the front door. Valet service in back, curbside check-in out front & convenient parking garage at the end of the block.Fremont Experience just a block away. Great location at a good price!

reviews.title: Overall great experience I would recommend it to everyone
reviews.text: The room was cozy and clean housekeeping staff were able to keep me with clean towels the pool was warm the gambling room was warm

reviews.title: No pool to enjoy!
reviews.text: The pool was out of service one day and the other there was a private party and that ruined my family's fun unfortunately. The pool was basically the only reason why my daughters decided to come with us to vegas and they couldn't enjoy their stay

reviews.title: Daughters 21st birthday in vegas
reviews.text: We had some slight issues with our room being serviced. And couples fighting throughout the halls. But otherwise it was a wonderful experience for my daughters 21st birthday celebration in vegas. We had a amazing time and the door man was so polite and attentive.

reviews.title: Loved it 😍
reviews.text: Perfect location only a few steps away from Fremont St Experience and Fremont East art district. Lots of really good food options  near by. Only issue we had was our toilet seat was broken so it would keep sliding when you sit not a big deal but annoying. Room was clean staff was really nice and pricing was very reasonable compared to the strip area. I would stay again.

reviews.title: Clean and spacious rooms- Pool is terrible!!
reviews.text: The main reason for a poor review is the pool area is filthy! The furniture and the walkway to the pool are dirty, torn and stained. The rooms were very nice in the tower, clean and spacious. The location is good for old Vegas- close to Freemont street. There are very few blackjack tables so we could not get a seat Thursday or Friday night after waiting for over an hour.

reviews.title: Not Pet Friendly
reviews.text: I booked a room specifically because their website says that they are pet friendly. When I tried to check in at 3 in the morning after driving cross country with my cat, they informed me cats were not allowed and turned me away. This hotel sucks

reviews.title: Nice for the price
reviews.text: There was no refrigerator or microwave. The lighting in the room could be way better. Shower had a weird leak that would make the water hit the ceiling. Other than that my stay was nice and I would return for the price and distance to freemont and the mob musuem.

reviews.title: What I was looking for
reviews.text: Perfect location and really great staff.  No problems of any kind.  Room was clean and had a great sunrise view of the mountains.   Casino is a good laid back experience.   Never had to ask twice for anything.   A little noise at night but to be expected.

reviews.title: Dated, but fantastic!
reviews.text: Wanted to start by saying the room was so much larger than I expected! The bed was so comfortable, and the pillows doubly so. The room was very clean, and I didn't mind walking without shoes. Yes, the room was slightly dated, but neither of us minded. Would've liked a coffee maker! 😄The breakfast was also fantastic. The fritter and almond croissant the best! Thank you Royale for all your support and help checking in and checking out. You made it so easy.

reviews.title: April 2024
reviews.text: There is no microwave or refrigerator. The room sitting Chair was full of mildew. Besides the fact, the staff was very welcoming and was there any time you needed them. Words words words words words words words words words words words words. Typed words to fill the character limit

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel in amazing location
reviews.text: I love the Downtown Grande! I tell all my friends it’s one of the best hotel options in  Vegas. The front desk has some wonderful staff. Especially Andrea. I was having a chaotic travel day having lost a credit card the night before. When I got to the front desk my whole wallet was missing. I was close to breaking down but she kept me calm and saved the day. The wallet was found and we were upgraded because of my status with the app I booked with. The room was gorgeous we were in the gallery tower and I loved it. Super easy access to the pool (which was also so nice) you don’t have to pay a fortune for a place to sit. This was in April.We loved the location. Not far from Fremont and across the street from Hog’s and Heffers on of the best bars in Vegas! We will be back and we will tell everyone we know to stay at the downtown grand!

reviews.title: Will stay again!
reviews.text: We had one of those corner rooms that had two doors.  The first led to a little foyer before your actual door.   I did not care for that.  Otherwise the rooms are great.   The stay was pretty good as they put up with us and our bicycles but we spent a lot of money at their restaurant, bar, and coffee shops.  Good food and late hours was a plus.  And always tried to leave the other guest on the elevators first.   I hope a bad apple doesn't ruin it for us!

reviews.title: Lilian, with one L!!
reviews.text: The receptionist I spoke to, Lilian (with one L) was so helpful and easy to talk to!! She has an amazing personality, is kind and efficient!! 10/10, this employee is top notch!!! One of a kind!

reviews.title: Absolutely fantastic!
reviews.text: Fantastic hotel! Absolutely brilliant location, right next to Fremont but away from the noise. Lovely rooms. Excellent coffee shop in the lobby. Great gym, nice pool. Staff were super friendly. Loved everything about it and will absolutely stay here every time I come to Vegas. Make sure you look up at the ceiling in the lobby waiting area! Now I know why it’s called the Art Bar.

reviews.title: The stay at the Grand
reviews.text: Stay was nice! I just feel like the hotels should have shuttles to get to the Strip. Other than that everything was fine.. friendly staff except for the guy checking us in… he asked very personal questions that had nothing to do with him. But anyways happy to be going back home!! #GoBlue!

reviews.title: No play
reviews.text: Hotel room was good. Disappointed no frig $20 extra. Room wasn't cleaned on Sunday and I guess we put Dealers on the Roulette table that don't even know the rules cause she messed up twice and pit boss had to fix and explain it to her.  We left the table.

reviews.title: Wonderful experience with friends! I will be back!
reviews.text: I loved everything about my stay from the looks of the room the amazing large bathroom. The casino floor was always so clean. The restaurants and bars downstairs were easy and good I did have a from the looks of the room the amazing large bathroom. The casino floor was always so clean. The restaurants and bars downstairs were easy and good. I did have an issue with n issue with the air turns its self off on a timer. My only downfall

reviews.title: Great downtown hotel!
reviews.text: The hotel was very nice and clean. The showers are a bit odd, but overall enjoyed my stay. Our keys stopped working about 30-40 minutes prior to checkout, however the staff was able to provide new ones without issue. I would recommend to anyone staying downtown.

reviews.title: NO REGARD FOR THE SAFETY AND SECURITY OF THEIR GUESTS
reviews.text: The staff of the Downtown Grand Hotel does not care about the safety and security of their guests.  For two days during our stay, there was an ongoing domestic situation/physical altercation taking place between a couple in the room next to us and they did virtually nothing about it.  It was completely over the top and something that I’ve never experienced, and it takes a lot to get me upset or concerned.  We brought it to their attention and they completely downplayed it and basically referred to it as a “conversation” and explained that “the walls were thin”.  While it was going on, it got so bad between them that it became physical with a significant amount of banging and loud noises, right against our wall.  My wife literally had a panic attack and was afraid to leave the room.  The hotel staff and the manager were so nonchalant and matter-of-fact about it, and seemed bothered by us raising the concern because “people can do what they want in the privacy of their own room”.  The staff and the manager were completely unapologetic about the whole situation.  It was sickening.  Obviously, they did absolutely nothing to “make it right”.  This wasn’t our first time staying there, but this will certainly be our last.  I realize now that this place is low rent.  I should have kept my original reservation with Golden Nugget and spent a little extra money.   I recommend that others do the same, that is, don’t stay at the Downtown Grand.  Trust me.  By the way, this is the first time I’ve ever been motivated to write a review for anything.  So, that should tell you something about how poorly they handled this situation.  Lastly, housekeeping services were non-existent (room not cleaned once during 4 night stay) and bell service was terrible (had to wait a long time to get luggage to leave for the airport and had to ask the front person three times before he walked over and got it for me).

reviews.title: GALLERY TOWER 3815
reviews.text: Love the Grand. Pluses are close to some amazing restaurants.    Room had no place to sit and could not bring up even a small chair when requested. Pad of paper and pen would have been nice.   Will stay again. Staff friendly.  Pool was very nice.....

reviews.title: Downhill
reviews.text: This used to get a great place. Unfortunately the lack of attention to cleaning and the condition of the parking garage paint a picture of inept, budget oriented management. They have reduced the in room amenities and removed the coffee makers, refrigerators and basically reduced it to bare bones. They had one elevator running in the Grand Tower. It's a vicious cycle when services and upkeep are reduced to cut minor cost, but they lower the cost to appeal to a lower demographic and are running bare bones. I have stayed there probably more than 20 times but they have lost me as a customer. Id rather pay the extra money and have the amenities and cleanliness back

reviews.title: Room for improvement
reviews.text: Arrived at 2am after driving all day. Hostile front desk person who talked down to me and acted like she was on the end of a 24 hour shift. Had to leave my ID to borrow a cart.I reserved a roll away cot and called an hour early to say we were on our way and to please have it up in the room so my kid could sleep (2am). However, upon arrival, was snapped at that they won’t bring it up until arrival. Took almost 30 minutes. Front desk tried to charge me $20 even though I reserved the room the day before on their website which said it was $15. “Prices went up last week!” and demanded to know which third party website I had used. Management, your mobile website was garbage and your right hand is not communicating with your left. Again, exhausted and interrogated trying to check in. I’ve worked in hospitality/front desk and customer service was utter garbage.Pet friendly hotel that charges $75 up to two pets. I selected this when booking. Again, questioned if they were service animal, which I thought was weird. I said it’s an ESA, but didn’t see the relevance. Then talked down to again like I was trying to get away with something? No, I opted for the pet fee. Why am I being treated like this?Parking is included in resort fee, but you have to walk a block. Spring for valet if mobility is an issue. I rode the elevator with a security guy in the parking garage.Hotel is only one block from Fremont Street. I stayed here in February and enjoyed the stay. However, don’t stay here is you are a light sleeper who goes to bed early. They have a basket of ear plugs at the front desk as the Fremont Street Experience blasts ungodly levels of music to the wee hours of the morning, especially weekends.There is a great blackjack table downstairs $5 bets & was a lot of fun and friendly for gaming newbs.Checkout was so much better, especially the bell hop staff. So friendly, kind, and helpful. Thank you! Not sure if I’ll return even though I enjoyed my stay two months ago.Room was fine. Only two pillows on king bed.

reviews.title: Had a great stay.
reviews.text: My husband and I spent 4 nights at the DTG. We had a great time and will definitely return. We’ve stayed at various, higher end hotels on the strip, in the past. I enjoyed trying something different. Our room was in the gallery tower. It was quiet and clean. I did request a quiet room and to be honest, I don’t think we heard anything. No outside noise, no noise from neighbours. I found the ease and convenience while staying at this hotel to be great. Forget something in your room? Takes 5 mins to grab and go back to lobby. Lots of good restaurants around. Casino hoping was fun and although everything is still expensive, it’s not strip prices. Don’t expect it to be 5 stars, they don’t clean your room everyday unless you ask etc. but these things did not bother me. I asked for water to be brought to my room, it was there in 10 mins. Staff was polite and friendly. Casino was clean and the hotel smelt fresh. You also can’t beat a 2 dollar hot dog and beer!

reviews.title: Saved me in my time of need!
reviews.text: This is the best most awesome hotel in Vegas!! I had issues with friends and needed to buy an extra room mid trip and they gave it to me at a huge discount. Every person who works her is awesome!! The pool is awesome and it is literally so centrally located a few blocks to Fremont. The room was clean and spacious.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: I booked a room they told me it was a pull view got there I got a street view The music was blasting all night long finally went off like two or 3:00 a.m. and then at 5:30 a.m. I got a trash truck beep beep beep and then when I thought that was over as somebody fired up a blower I'm over it and the restaurant breakfast was absolutely hideous

reviews.title: My new favorite hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: The Grand was excellent! Clean ~ staff were very friendly.  Justin & Jennie at the ArtCafe were amazing!  They were a perfect  start to each day. We were close to Fremont - on a very safe street!  Pizza Rock was delicious. Grand offers a great coupon for the Mob Museum. I felt very safe - which to me is very important.  I usually stay at Aria ~ now the Grand is my favorite!

reviews.title: Great Find
reviews.text: Great location near Fremont Street, the Mob museum, and some local eateries. Safer than being right on the strip, and quieter too. Rooms were standard.  Nice Jazz bar located right i side hotel. Casino was small but nice and clean, good service. Rewards program left some things to be desired.

reviews.title: Fun place just off Fremont St
reviews.text: Clean and comfortable as usual. The games paid well and Jody the evening bartender was awesome! Easy access to rides to the strip. Food at nearby bars and steakhouse all within a short walk as well. Could use a cooler and coffee maker in the room though, only negative.

reviews.title: Noisy, but clean room
reviews.text: This hotel is near an all night party that goes into the next morning,  apparently every day.  Even on the 17th floor we could hear thumping music into the wee hours of the morning.  There is a sign in the room letting you know about the issue and offering earplugs from the front desk.  So to be fair, my rating does not take the noise into account because many folks will think that's great.  It's located in a party zone, we just did not know about it before hand.  I have stayed in Vegas before, and I know its a party town, but this was over the top.Pros-The room itself was clean.Lots of drawers and cabinet space to unpack.Quick,  friendly check in.Reasonable priced for Las VegasFree Parking.Cons-The seemingly never ending noise from the street.The elevators and hallways themselves were not clean.The stairwells of the parking garage were filled with empty beer/alcohol bottles.  (had to literally step over and around some)Parking garage elevators not working, so had to take the stairs.Resort fee with no particular benefit attached.Pillows- only two thinner pillows on each queen size bed and no extra in room.Tip for Management-   when someone reserves a room send them an auto reply e-mail or text letting them know about the nearby party zone and that it wont be a quiet stay. Average is a fair score for this place.

reviews.title: Give it a try! We did and it’s one of our favorites.
reviews.text: This is our 2nd stay here this year. We are happy with the following: 1. The coffee (excellent expresso downstairs)2. Customer Service (friendly staff, Aundrea helped us at check-in) 3. Location (near Fremont but not on it) 4. Clean, modern & looking good (casino & hotel) 5. Value (excellent price)  6. Fitness room & pool area (on point)

reviews.title: only one issue....
reviews.text: For the most part, we had a great experience.  Especially, we enjoyed the Black Jack tournament and $5 Black Jack table.  The only problem was that smell of Marijuana came from the next room through the connecting door.   I contacted the front desk and they said they will send security.  So I waited for a while, but no one came....  So when I checked out the room, I had to go to the front desk and explain that the smell is not us.  I had to make sure they do not charge us a fine for that.  I just had a bad luck with a neighbor.....

reviews.title: Fam Vac
reviews.text: Reserved 3 Room’s. Supposedly they were giving credit per room but never received.  They still charged me for room service.  BEWARE. Too many amenities were closed. Free Breakfast,  is Free,  that’s it. Morning young bartender guy has an attitude,  still hasn’t grown up.

reviews.title: Pleasant staff and clean, will stay there again
reviews.text: Great clean rooms, Good dining just off Fremont St making location 5 Star place to stay Pleasant and affordable. Parking is included, safe and well monitored. From the minute we walked in, staff was there to answer all questions with a smile.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: The room was really nice for the price and the whole place was extremely clean and didn’t have the dreaded cigarette smoke smell.  So many food options within the hotel (which was delicious and at a reasonable price) and walking distance! Loved that the director John was on the floor introducing himself and speaking to guest!  Will definitely be staying here again and referring others!

reviews.title: Nice location
reviews.text: Really liked the hotel. Clean large rooms greeted by friendly representative upon check in.  Small casino with assorted table games and slot machines. Beer and a hot dog for 2 dollars. Free parking and wifi. We didn't try the restaurant but it look nice.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: This hotel was right next to Fremont Street. The location was fantastic. The hotel and room was very clean and the staff was friendly and helpful. The bed was very comfortable. We enjoyed everything about our stay and would definitely stay there again next time.

reviews.title: Family get together
reviews.text: The rooms were very nice  updated pillows super soft.  The color schemes were very welcomed.  Need to get more new slot machines.  Will be back. Close to freemont  experience, The band that played live at the bar in casino was very good, dancing ,drinking,gambling what else do you need..

reviews.title: The good location isn't everything!
reviews.text: This was my second time here and the loyalty didn't pay off. Annoying that I didn't choose another hotel. The earplugs are the only service, but they are also necessary. Various noises from other rooms throughout, very noisy house. The bathroom is missing toilet brush and soap, shower gel, shampoo, whatever.

reviews.title: Nice look but noisy
reviews.text: Not that impressed with the room. No microwave, small compact room, limited table space, and storage. Very modern looking, bathroom was small but functional shower only, one sink. What really bothered me was the noise...I could hear footsteps and baggage being dropped from the rooms on the next level and people coming in late at night down the hallway. Not just next door but four or five doors down. It was very noisy during the night.

reviews.title: Satisfied yet unsatisfied
reviews.text: I have stayed at the grand on several  occasions and the staff have been outstanding up until my last visit. My stay was for five days. Yet when I checked in there was a black male at check in who was very rude as I am black also when I requested to stay in a certain tower he rolled his eyes at me and just ignored my request   and placed me in a room just across from the motorcycle club. Also the house keeping was not thorough for I was in room 3460 and noticed beer bottles next to the wall by che chase lounge. I also purchased my own toilet tissue which was taken and replaced with house tissue

reviews.title: Happy We Stayed!
reviews.text: Will stay here again!I took my 79 year old mom to Vegas.  I was looking for a place that was close to a lot of casinos so she wouldn’t have to walk around too much.  I found a great deal for Downtown Grand and heard positive feedback from a good friend before I decided to book.What made me decide to come here again are the people:1. Check in was smooth and quick (a little after midnight Thursday morning).  The person who checked us in passed on some helpful information, such as a heads up about the crazy weekend parking situation and what to do.2. The team at the Art Bar was great.  They made our mornings!  They were always busy but got everyone their orders quickly and efficiently.  Their muffins were yummy!  My mom got her green tea and I got my latte.  Win win!3. The attendants at the 3rd Street entrance (I felt) always kept an eye out for us.  I would pick up and drop off mom at that entrance whenever we were coming and going.  They always made sure she got safely in the building and had a seat at the Art Bar while she waited for me to park.  They would chat with her while she waited outside for me to pick her up.4. Vincent from guest services is a true ambassador of hospitality.  He helped us unload the car after a Target run.  My mom did not feel comfortable walking to the room with Vincent and our purchases while I parked the car (only because she’s very cautious).  Vincent quickly recognized her discomfort and offered to wait in the lobby with her until I returned so we could all walk upstairs together.  Then almost every morning after that, he would always greet us outside of the Art Bar and ask us what we were up to that day!  He always put a smile on our faces.  Any time someone can be kind to my mom and make her smile… they earn bonus points.  Vincent certainly earned a bunch of bonus points!The building was in good condition.  Rooms were well maintained.The only reasons for scoring “4” was:No refrigerator in the roomHousekeeping did not service the room for the first two days, which was fine with us.  When we asked for extra towels, it took them about 30 minutes to deliver.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Clean, comfortable hotel close to fun Fremont Street activities. The staff here is phenomenal: helpful, friendly, and attentive. Great drinks in the bar and breakfasts were delicious and filling. I would definitely book a room here the next time I am in Vegas.

reviews.title: Love Downtown Grand
reviews.text: I prefer the downtown area and the opportunity to walk and explore the local area eateries and tap rooms. The Art District is my favorite. Love the Downtown Grand! Clean room and comfy bed.  Staff was delightful. Second stay . Will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Good location
reviews.text: Great location close to Fremont downtown. A little tough with parking across the street. There should be designated sorties for hotel guests. Almost didn’t have a place to park. Valet was a little rude as well and later that night it was full also.

reviews.title: Great place to stay, just off Freemont...easy in and out !
reviews.text: The beds were nice. The rooms were clean. They actually had maid service which is rare these days.  Fresh towels daily and a cleaned room. Triple George 's was excellent dining, ate there twice. Great breakfast if you add that option.  Small nice casino, not too smokey. Parking was a bit of an issue.

reviews.title: Downtown Grand a great Vegas stay
reviews.text: Stayed at Downtown Grand last week multiple nights and had a great experience. The staff reached out by text before my stay for pre registration and room availability. Rooms comfortable and casino fun. The $2 hot dogs with Pabst hit the spot!!  Will definitely book again

reviews.title: Terrible First Impression
reviews.text: Where do I start? Check in was a nightmare. We were given the wrong directions for where to even find valet from the person standing out front who after we drove around the block twice told us it was his first day! Well, we finally found valet where we sat out front for 10 minutes, waiting for somebody to assist us, my husband had to go inside to the casino to find a bellhop. We finally get to the room where we discover it, a chilly 66° and we are unable to adjust the thermostat because it is broken. Trying to make the best of a lousy experience I decided to shower, after now 10 hours of travel, where  I find there’s no hot water. Honestly you can’t make this stuff up they offered to change our room but now it’s 1015 and I’m exhausted we’re going to bed and checking out in the morning.

reviews.title: Fees
reviews.text: Fees are misleding when you check in. Too many feesRoom was nice but shower did not work properly.  Liked the casino just right for a single guest not too big. Good for an older person like myself.  I will check more carefully the next time becuase all of the fees.

reviews.title: Exceptional at The Grand. Stay Downtown.
reviews.text: Loved my stay. The staff is exceptional. Stay here and see what I mean. Geoffrey and Royale at the front desk are solid dudes. The beautiful young ladies that manage the desk are excellent and caring as well as eager to help. Visit the bar and see Robert, L, Eli, and Alyssa for intelligent conversation and 4 star service.

reviews.title: Super nice hotel and good price
reviews.text: Very nice hotel for price ., check in lady super nice and informative.  First night we ate at their restaurant , bar tender was super kind.  Second night I came to bar to grab a straw from bar and the bartender they had was very rude, he said “ mam if you need something , ask us”. I was confused and said “ it’s just a straw “ he responded “ we will grab it for you “ he was older dirty looking guy with glasses. Basically a male “Karen” Other than that, loved the hotel.

reviews.title: Over all not to bad
reviews.text: All was good, except for the waitress service in the casino. There was a couple of nights we didn’t see a waitress around the slots. They were all hanging around the card tables. The booths in the freedom beat restaurant could use a cleaning there was a lot crumbs in the seats.

reviews.title: Good location, decent hotel.
reviews.text: Parking here is a pain, while there is a load/unload zone right in front, you have to park in a nearby garage and the elevator there was down (I have knee issues so the ramps up were not fun.)  Be SURE to get a parking pass before the first time you exit.  No one told us this and we ended up with a credit to use in the coffee shop for the $18 parking fee.  The doormen are great and fast, especially James.  Everything was nice and clean although the only amenities in our room were the ice bucket and cups.  No soaps and minimal towels.

reviews.title: Loved the Downtown Grand Hotel!
reviews.text: The pillows were the fluffiest we’ve  felt in a very long time.. Front desk was awesome..Loved the customer service that they gave us. It was so easy to get things by texting them..greatest idea ever!!!!  The room was so roomy. We even won at the machines.!!!!

reviews.title: Great but things need to be fixed
reviews.text: Pros the rooms are very spacious, the beds are comfortable, the T.V. had Netflix. The Fat Cat bar was nice and enjoyable. The locais really great to. CONS no coffee pot in the room. The walls are thin I got woken up every morning by our neighbor talking non stop for hours by the third morning I was woken up by her talking I used ear plugs to sleep after being woken up by her again. The pool was closed. The elevator was scary, my husband got stuck in ome of them they were making weird noises so we took the stairs. The freedom restaurant blows don't eat there.

reviews.title: Quick Get away
reviews.text: This was a very comfortable stay. My room was in the grand tower which was very quiet and close to the amazing gym. The pillows were perfect, the bathroom was spacious, and the extra bottles of water were greatly appreciated.  The location was perfect. Lots of food and fun, but away from the noise of the main strip.

reviews.title: Beautiful, BUT Bummed out,
reviews.text: The suit advertises our room would have a mini fridge, and that some rooms would have microwave, then another selling point was their beautiful pool. Well none of that is true. Well I don’t know about some of the rooms having microwaves, but ours didn’t which is fine. We didn’t need it but the rest was not true. We purchased things that needed to be refrigerated thinking we had a fridge. So that was a waste of money. Then mirrors were filthy, And filthy in the sense that like there were streaks on it, but filthy like whoever was there last brush their teeth, and the overspray was still on the mirror The final disappointment was when we went up to the pool area and loved the view. It was completely gorgeous however, guess what pool was closed yet  it doesn’t say that online in fact, they advertise about the pool. Not huge things to be upset about. In fact I wouldn’t say don’t go there because it’s a beautiful hotel but I do feel like they should be a little bit more honest with their selling points. Along with clean mirrors walking in and seeing a dirty mirror makes you question, what else didn’t get cleaned like the bedding I’m not saying it wasn’t clean but I’m just saying that’s where your head goes

reviews.title: Very Good
reviews.text: Very busy place but they accommodated us very well. I would suggest for anyone to try it. Our first time in Vegas and everyone was so helpfull. In a decent part of town felt safe. Had plenty of games and machines to play. We had no trouble finding things to do in this hotel

reviews.title: Peaceful night good sleep
reviews.text: This hotel room was Clean    comfy clean ibed  and a spotless Clean bathroom.   Quite and peaceful night.  No noise in the Hallways and casino was calm.   Music wasn't loud from fremont could bearly hear it.  But then it was a Thursday night  Friday check out was easy all. Online valet was quick at getting our car.

reviews.title: Best place off the strip
reviews.text: Great atmosphere! Great host. Could use a little help at the craps table. Also the $1 blackjack was full all the time... Open another table. When I walked on the floor in the morning I was served coffee within the first 5 minutes, no that's great service

reviews.title: Resort fees
reviews.text: I have a hard time paying for a resort fee. Especially when the pool is t open. So I went down to the front desk and asked why I’m paying it. This what I was told. Wi-Fi, 2 bottles of water and the pool. I said the pool isn’t open, I was told I am able to sit by the pool. I reminder the employee most people don’t need Wi-Fi and bottled water can be purchased at the store for .50 cents. She removed the fees which was wonderful. But I think as travelers we need to ask about these fees. They are just to make the hotel richer.

reviews.title: Overall great. Just one bad employee that should be fired.
reviews.text: The bar tender around ten pm last night was extremely rude.  I had been waiting for a simple coca collar while playing Keno for nearly a half hour. Finally went to the bar to get one and he tried charging me $4 and was completely unprofessional and a real jerk. Spending hundreds of dollars at your Casino the last few days I would expect better and nicer service.

reviews.title: Best kept secret of the Fremont experience!
reviews.text: Outstanding customer service. Every staff member went out their way for us, from the door man to the bell hop & to the front desk. Rooms are modern, clean, neat & spacious. The casino and restaurants were well kept and available around the clock for service. A+++

reviews.title: Clean hotel, slow check-in, cleaning is 6 days or later
reviews.text: The hotel is clean, rooms are as described. Checkin took an hour, room temps cannot be adjusted, no one can tell you how often they clean rooms, just that they don't do it daily. We had to call to get fresh towels. Staff was friendly. Temp is set at 68.

reviews.title: Poor. Wish I had taken photos
reviews.text: We stayed Monday thru Friday.  Hotel 1 block from Freemont street. Cheap gambling min. Upon checking in we were informed there will be no cleaning of our room for the 1st. 3 days. On the 4th day I texted them to please clean our room. Which they did. Ro9m was small Safe was located on the bottom area of closet. Had to get on my  knees to open it. One morning about 8am,I went down to main  gambling area of casino bar,with my coffee cup, I asked the bar waitress if I could please have some coffee. She asked if I was playing a slot machine.  I responded not right now, but I'm staying here all week. She again replied you have to be playing a machine. I went to front desk and  complained. Front desk stated that was hotel policy.  I replied I will never stay here again.  In which front desk didn't seem to care.  Oh also was playing craps one night. They had to shut down half the craps table lack of help.

reviews.title: Good room but service is lacking
reviews.text: This hotel was okay. The location is just off Fremont Street. They provide in room coffee and bottled water at no charge. The only problem was getting them. My room was serviced by the first night but that was all. I requested coffee and water but they never brought it, even after multiple requests. I offered to go get it but the front desk doesn’t keep either on hand. It’s a housekeeping thing. Other than that, the room was clean and the bed comfortable.

reviews.title: Definitely not great.
reviews.text: Don't ask the front desk for anything (like water sent to room) because you won't get it even after 2 requests.  Room service must be requested because they are understaffed,  but they don't tell you that at check in. Freedom beat diner no good.

reviews.title: Wonderful first time experience staying downtown at the Grand.
reviews.text: First of all, let me say the this was my first experience staying in downtown LV.  I know a lot of people love the shiny corporate look of the new strip mega resorts.  I personally like new as well, but I prefer it blended with some historical content.  Once they drop the Trop most of the original history of the strip will have vanished.  What the owners of the Downtown Grand have done is take an existing structure, add a new contemporary (Gallery) tower with wonderfully modern and spacious rooms to a collection of amenities (Gym, rooftop pool, jazz club) that form a cohesive and easy to use property.  Like many I had to question just how different the DTLV experience might be compared to the strip.  Fair enough right? I like historic neighborhoods so this would involve walking through the nicely developing Fremont East area. No problem. Security everywhere all times of day! If you want genuine Vegas history strolling up and down this stretch of Fremont should do it for you.  If nothing else at least stop into Atomic Liquors and ask about the history of the bar.  What's happening on Fremont is very similar to the gentrification going on in most large US cities older areas. New apartments, galleries and really fun food/bev choices. To be fair, Yes, there are homeless, but fewer than I have encountered in most major urban centers and no more than you see on the strip. No one bothered me in fact a few just said Hi. This was during the day. Obviously, you would want to be extra cautious at night, just like on the strip. Now back to the Grand.  New Gallery rooms are really nice. Elegant bathrooms with modern fixtures. There are a lot of reviews that mention the half wall glass enclosure in the shower stall. I found that if you just turn the shower head a little towards the wall the floor stays dry. Easy fix. It is very stylish.  The bed was really comfortable - not to hard or soft and the four thick pillows are perfect. A feature I found comforting was an additional flip type lock on the door. Great idea! My room was spotless and I'm kinda picky on this point.  Even the remote was clean. Lots of fluffy towels and two bottles of water (free) every day.  Noise level depends on a combination of location and events held at the pool on certain days.  The three nights I was here it was really quite. My room faced 4th across from Gold Spike so just a little noise in the evening. Not bad. They provide ear plugs but I did not use them and I'm a light sleeper.  The gym is clean and has new machines and is open 24/7! I can't say enough about this hotel. I love it and they forever changed my perception of downtown Vegas.  If you like museums like I do, the MOB is right across the street and the Neon is about three blocks behind the hotel (I don't recommend walking to the Neon though). The Art Bar coffee shop in the lobby is awesome.  Also try Public Us down at 9th and Fremont for breakfast.  The DTG completely changed my perception of staying downtown. Give them a try. I think you will be impressed with just how hard they try and how much pride they take in their product.

reviews.title: Clean, safe
reviews.text: The rooms are very clean and the bed was very comfortable.  The only bad thing the room didn't have a microwave nor a fridge.  My family and I felt very safe in this hotel.  They have a lot of security to keep your family safe.. I will stay here again. Had a blast!!

reviews.title: View Amenities closely per room
reviews.text: The hotel was nice the beds were soft the pillows were good. The doorman the belhops in all customer service were excellent. The downtown grand accepted pets.The only bad thing is they did not have a dog walker or a dog park.. If your dog is used to going potty in the grass there is none around. There is a nice parking lot across the street that has gravel over by the Mob museum, which is in excellent venue. We stayed in the grand deluxe with dbl queen bed portion of the hotel which was fine. They did not provide a coffee machine, microwave or refrigerator in the room.So make sure you bring ice and your own coffee machine if you need to. Although there is a coffee shop downstairs of course. One last thing they advertise $1 blackjack, but it's actually $5.All in all, we had a great time.Thank you

reviews.title: Great location, rooms need improvement
reviews.text: Bed was not comfortable, looked promising online but was a little bit let down on the room for our mini staycation for our anniversary. Hotel and casino was friendly and nice though, and it is convenient to Fremont street, great food, and stuff to do.

reviews.title: Best Hotel off of Fremont Street!
reviews.text: We absolutely love The Downtown Grand!  Very clean and chill atmosphere.  You get all the benefits of staying on Fremont without the noise and craziness.  The staff are exceptional and always available.  The beds and pillows are top notch for comfort and had me sleeping the best I’ve ever slept in Vegas!

reviews.title: Nice hotel in a loud area
reviews.text: A pleasant stay in a vibrant part of Vegas.Good facilities and reception. The suite was large and generous with a bathtub. Only down side was the noise at night from the bar opposite which was very loud. Only warning was a pot-it note on the bathroom mirror offering ear plugs

reviews.title: Downtown Grand-Vegas
reviews.text: Very comfortable beds, clean room. Located in a good spot and a nice casino floor. Two complaints, lack of coffee in room and backed up shower drain. A little noisy at night but hey, it's Vegas and ear plugs were provided. I would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: FANTASTIC Freemont  Street  Hotel
reviews.text: Amazing  staff...great restaurant  called Freedom Beat Jennifer  always  takes good care of me as  casino  host. QUIET  but still close to the action  of Freemont Street. Gallery Tower is worth  the upgrade!! Free coffee  and water daily. My favorite  downtown  hotel  by far.

reviews.title: not so smooth
reviews.text: When we checked in at the front desk, we were told where to go park and we were given a parking pass. At that time I asked her if she was sire because the bell hop told us that the parking garage was full and we needed to go to the overflow garage. She assured us we would be able to park in the regular garage.  That was NOT the case. We had ro park in the overflow garage and the parking pass would not work in that garage.  It was a nightmare after such a long drive.

reviews.title: Live-deal blackjack with low minimum bets
reviews.text: Found the $1 minimum live-dealer blackjack tables and spent a happy hour there! Nice people, complimentary drinks and you're not losing your money too fast... the bar's also good. Would definitely visit next time I'm in town, even if it was the "wrong end" from us.

reviews.title: Don’t go here!
reviews.text: Worst hotel I’ve ever stayed at. The parking garage was full so I had to pay to park and when I was able too park there the elevator didn’t work so walking down 6 flights of stairs is not ideal. My room was a disappointment they overbooked and I got out in a room with tiny double beds instead of the king bed room I asked for, there was no white noise machine and to make things worse the walls and ceilings are paper thin !! Sounded like elephants above us all night. So we checked out 2 days early and went somewhere else. Highly do NOT recommend!!

reviews.title: Pros and Cons of This Hotel
reviews.text: I stayed there for three nights.  Over the years I have stayed at many hotels in Vegas, both on the Strip and downtown.  There are pros and cons to the Grand.There is no shuttle service by the hotel to the airport; it costs about $50 plus tip for cab and $25-35 plus tip for Uber.   There is free parking across the street at 333 E Ogden if you have a bar code from the hotel.  Check-in was efficient (at 2 pm).  The room was clean and quiet (2nd floor), with blackout curtains and good TV and soft beds, but the shower and sink water was never hot, just warm, morning and evening, no matter how long I let it run.  On the first morning, there were no coffee cups, but they were requested and arrived. Then we learned that the coffee maker did not work; we asked that it be replaced, but that never happened.  Each morning we had to go to lobby to buy coffee in the snack shop (which had very cheerful morning staff from 6 am).   There is no daily maid service unless requested, but when I asked for more towels I got them quickly.  When I failed to print out my boarding pass, the front desk did it for me without complaint.  There is no lobby house phone.The casino is my favorite in all Vegas!  Not too big or small, usually not crowded or smoky during the day.  I do not gamble after 5.  Cashier Bee is always smiling!Across the street is a GREAT pizza place that sells by the slice, and the slices are HUGE.  I certainly recommend it. The dining room in the hotel was good, with competitive prices: I had one breakfast and one dinner there.  At dinner there was no non-herbal tea--NOT good for any restaurant.All in all, would I return? >Yes, but the lack of hot water is a real problem.

reviews.title: New Jazz Club Elevates The Downtown Grand!
reviews.text: We really like The Downtown Grand. We visit Las Vegas once a year for our son’s soccer tournament, and we always stay here.  The rooms are well appointed and the beds are very comfortable. We have found the food  to be quite good, and we enjoy the pool deck on warm days. The free parking and easy access on and off the highway is ideal.  We always stay in the new building rooms (Gallery Tower). And, the new Rockabilly/Jazz lounge, Fat Cats, is a gem! Creative, handcrafted cocktails, and a taste of the local music scene makes it one of a kind.   DTLV isn’t for travelers looking for the plastic sheen of the strip to the south. But if you are looking for an eclectic, slightly retro Las Vegas experience, stay at the Downtown Grand. The only downside is the casino itself is a bit smokier then some of the others we’ve visited.  This is countered by the fact that they have $1 tables during the day.

reviews.title: Really Bad Service
reviews.text: Let’s just say it’s starts with the Valet. Someone who could care less about offering service. Then, you get a check in line with 30 people in it and 2 employees working the front desk. Don’t need to say anything else. If your booked here you should cancel and go anywhere else.

reviews.title: Excellent if you’re Downtown
reviews.text: The room was really clean and simple, but that’s all we needed staying downtown. I do think this is the best place to stay near Fremont, but the amenities just are not like what you can get on the strip. The energy at the craps tables is fun because the staff are interactive. The $1 blackjack on Sundays is great!

reviews.title: Very nice hotel.
reviews.text: Well organized, well staffed, convenient location, free parking, comfortable rooms with good beds and great pillows!  Check in was well organized, the room was nicely done up and very clean, although the rooms are starting to get a bit worn around the edges. We opted for the bed and breakfast package, so there’s a great little bistro in the front lobby that provides a quick grab and go breakfast with a decent selection and really good coffee.  Location is easy to get to, and it’s just a quick stroll to Fremont Street and all that entails. Front desk staff were  very helpful and accommodating, definitely focusing on customer service. Would definitely consider staying there again.

reviews.title: Worst. Experience. Ever.
reviews.text: We reserved a room 3 months in advance and we got downgraded even though we were told it was an upgrade. Wasn’t in the slightest. Room was dirty. Clean your rooms better. Also, fix your online service for early check in. If you can’t do that, it should not be explained on a confirmation email that you can do so.Our experience was so disappointing here, we won’t be returning.

reviews.title: No housekeeping
reviews.text: They don’t provide daily housekeeping, when I called they said “you have to call”.   So don’t expect fresh towels and daily complementary water. You’re on your own. Love the proximity to Fremont Street, the hotel is clean and free parking for hotel guest.

reviews.title: Sleepless
reviews.text: Did not sleep half the night due to no one saying our room was directly above a bar which played looooouuuud music well into the night. Then found a post-it on bathroom mirror saying the front desk had earplugs. We stayed once before but on other side of hotel so did not know about music. Then the next morning when saying something when checking out the girl did not give a crap about what I had to say

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: The Hotel just plain sucks...The rooms are hot we called 4 times in an hour to get help no one ever came .The water is terrible There are no water stations or anywhere to sit other then in casino.customer service was rude And the halls and rooms smell awful

reviews.title: Supper Bowl
reviews.text: The service desk was great my room was not no phone serviceHad to keep going down to desk for needs . My toilet broke so we had to change rooms.The love place will stay again easy to see Vegas and food near by walking to street. But the music was loud at night it not bad

reviews.title: Superbowl Weekend
reviews.text: Never stayed in downtown Vegas before. Hotel was clean yet a bit basic/generic. Casino adequate but nothing special. Great location for Fremont experience. Cost to taxi/uber to strip for dinner not cheap. Staff very nice- best attribute

reviews.title: A Great Place for Gaming
reviews.text: Had a great time gaming at the Grand over Super Bowl weekend.  The lowest minimums - $1 blackjack and $5 craps- you’ll find either downtown or on the Strip.  Casino is nice, bright,  and comfortable.  And the $2 Nathan’s hot dog and PBR special has to be one of the best bargains in Las Vegas.  Convenient to the Fremont Street Experience, the Mob Museum, and other downtown sights.

reviews.title: Great Boutique Hotel
reviews.text: Clean rooms and comfortable beds in an awesome location.  The   casino is on the small side but it has a good variety of games to choose from.  The $2.00 Hotdog and PBR is an awesome deal.  The staff was friendly and helpful.  We will be staying at the DTG on our next trip!

reviews.title: Simple, clean, modern
reviews.text: The hotel was very modern and clean. It had the cheapest table games around ($5 craps and $1 blackjack). Maid service came every day, and we received two bottled waters for free daily. The hotel is only a block away from the middle of Fremont St., yet the noise from Fremont was manageable even without ear plugs. We’ll definitely come back.

reviews.title: Warning ⚠️  Warning⚠️ Unsafe Hotel Terrible Customer Service by Management and Security.
reviews.text: Warning Warnings Unsafe Hotel.Poor customer service from management and security. Homeless sleeping at machines. Parked in the parking garage. We could hear a woman screaming. She bag got snatched. No one helped her. The way my family was treated on my daughters birthday weekend was horrifying. First, my reservation was canceled, Greg was kindly he helped me. The next thing the housekeeping was making it difficult to get towels, I had to bring every towel out so they could count. So we passed on the room being cleaned. I called the front desk because someone threw up all over the hallway floors, and it was never clean. On our last day, We went to gamble before going to eat dinner at the Mayfair, We were harassed and threatened because of the staffed incapable of performing customer service. We had to stop the waitress to get drinks. She was not happy about that. I was told my husband better be playing a game when he stood up  from the game to say his order. After it took about 20-30 mins to get a drink, the drink tasted like there wasn’t any alcohol so I went to ask the waitress what type of alcohol was in the drink. After trying to ignore me, She had replied with an attitude stating “alcohol, you should know if you ordered a margarita it has alcohol”. So I decided to go to the bar and get a proper drink. When I asked the male bartender for a drink he told me to wait and did a full circle around the bar, at this point it was understood that the disrespect from the staff was going to continue. I went to the from desk and spoke with Greg, who has been respectful from the start and he tried to resolve the situation. Now Hoping that the staff would be able to do their job properly, I went and paid for a proper drink. While sitting at the bar my husband walked up to me, once again the waitress proceeded to be aggressive and derogatory stating that “ your wife is was talking derogatory to me” then my husband stated all she asked was what was in her drink, I am a customer and you shouldn’t be talking to customers like that. Then the other female waitress with the white jersey said they put a sip of alcohol in the drink and it would be better to buy the drink and still never said what was type of alcohol was in the drink. As we continue to gamble security spoke with her and got her sided of what happen. FIVE (5 )male security guards surrounded us in began to act in a threatening manner and told my husband, daughter and I  that we needed to leave. I asked why they stated that we were cussing and causing a problem. They never ask our side of the story. The security was still acting in a threatening manner.I told Them that there was no need for all of them to continue to act like that toward us. My daughter stated record because We felt threatening by security. My daughter was told that it was against the law to record  because it was private property. Then they told us to stay away from the bar. I walk away to go back to the front desk. I had already been to the front desk and complained about the waitress before security came over. I guess security realized that we had already been to the front desk  they proceeded get loud and stated that they never told us to leave and that they have no control over the way she was acts  That we can make a complaint against her. I brought to their attention. Their rude and disgusting behavior toward us. While speaking with Greg and Britney, once again, who have been kind and respectful, did what they could to fix what happened. The manager came out and spoke with greg and proceeded to talk to the other staff. Never addressed us or showed any concern for unlawful actions of their employees, so I called in and spoke to the manager Antoinette Collins. Who has never called me back or followed up with me. She stated she was doing an investigation. And would call me back. Greg and Britney should be a part of the management staff they have excellent customer service.

reviews.title: Awesomesauce!!!
reviews.text: It's a great hotel.  Food is wonderful,  and surrounding restaurants are on point.  Right at The  Fremont Street Experience too!!The hotel is beautiful.   Rooms are comfortable and spacious. The staff is friendly and extremely helpful.   Check in was quick, less than 5 minutes and Check out was faster.  They gave us a parking pass to use at the garage, which was a real blessing.  The casino is fun.  Not big, but lively still.  Cocktail waitresses, (Kelly on graveyard and Chris on the am shift) were very good and kept the drinks and coffee flowing.  Tried to tip as much as I could because they deserved it and more.  Sign up for their players card too.  Tons of benefits and promotions. Will definitely be back!!  Thank you so much.

reviews.title: Amazing service Great Location
reviews.text: We had a few challenges with the room etc... but Antionette at the front desk was so accommodating.   She helped us with every detail making our stay go from slightly frustrating to an amazing stay!.  Antoinette is an amazing employee who goes above and beyond to make sure everyone feels important and valued as a guest at the Downtown Grand Hotel and Casino near Fremont Street in Las Vegas!!  Enjoyed the Amazing location and extra perks like $2 hot dog and PBR and complimentary continental Breakfast!!

reviews.title: Crappy
reviews.text: I reserved 2 rooms with king beds and was told king beds were not available, I got 2 queen beds. That is crap tried to check in 3 different times. First time was told king rooms were not ready yet. Second time, one room was cleaned but needed inspection. Third time, I was told no king rooms were available. And had to accept 2 queen beds. I was with another couple and the consensus is both couples will never stay with you again..

reviews.title: Hotel is great……Area is getting worse.
reviews.text: Stayed in the new “Gallery” building. Very clean and fresh. Unfortunately when this section was built, the flooring probably wasn’t the greatest. You here a lot of creeks from unit above and our own creeked when we walked across the unit. Not a big deal, and not on the fault of the hotel itself.All the staff was courteous. From the front desk to the waitresses.I feel it is a very good deal for downtown.It has been six years since we’ve stayed downtown. All the casinos/hotels are freshened up and clean. Unfortunately Fremont Street has become a haven for the homeless and the legalization of pot is all over. Many old time employees said the last few years have become extreme.The downtown casinos are gonna need to band together and try and do something. It gonna definitely hurt further visitor numbers.My wife and I definitely enjoyed our stay at The Grand. Unfortunately the social scene will prevent us from visiting anytime soon.

reviews.title: Host is exceptional
reviews.text: Jennifer the host is amazing.  I have been dealing with Jennifer for a few years now.  I’ve been staying at the Grand for many years and had been considering changing hotels when in Vegas. Since I have met Jennifer I will not stay anywhere else. Her customer service is beyond exceptional.  I highly recommend her to all my friends This hotel has improved tremendously in the last 3 years. I’m sure she is behind the reason why !!

reviews.title: 100% recommended hotel and casino
reviews.text: One of my best experiences regarding a hotel stay in many trips to Vegas. Clean room, comfortable bed, friendly and helpful staff. Casino was awesome too. Plenty of games to choose from. Restaurant/bar has some great food. Free parking as well!

reviews.title: Bits are good bits are bad
reviews.text: This is a tough one. The hotel is modern with free guest parking and amazing $2 hotdog and beer. The food in the main bar was fantastic and staff were friendly. It is extremely close to Ferment street which is a good thing and a bad thing. That’s the positives but the real truth is the cleanliness of the room was pretty awful and the noise was horrendous. I actually thought the person staying above us was gonna come through into our room. They were just walking around.  It’s never a good sign when a hotel offers you ear plugs on checking into your room. The noise from Fremont street was loud as there seams to be no double glazing in the room we had. Also you get every boy racer dragging their car up and down the road early hours. We also had a sofa in the room that had clearly never been cleaned and had seen some heavy action. There was a large white water mark and what looked to be some sort of back passage material on this sofa.  There was dust on the tv stand. The coffee machine had a dirty bag in it and hadn’t been cleaned in a while it smelt.  We stayed for 2 nights and did tell staff upon checking out they seamed unfazed by what we said about the room.

reviews.title: Enjoyable stay at the downtown grand
reviews.text: Great experience at the downtown grand. Within walking distance of freemont and the mob museum. Easy access to bars and restaurants. Rooms weee clean and modern. Freedom beat restuarant had delicious food and the servers and bartenders were great. Casino was on the small side, but had the best ambiance of the casinos in the area. They utilize texting/website where you can submit any requests to the hotel. 100% recommend if you are staying downtown.

reviews.title: They are going to need to shape up for the superbowl.
reviews.text: Everything about was okay but the room heat turned off when I was sleeping and it was cold when I awoke. Also the garage stairs are dirty and looked like homeless or druggies lived in it. They were also renovating the casino floor.

reviews.title: 5 stars
reviews.text: It was a nice day it wasn't too loud the beds is really comfortable the heater could get a little higher it stays on 77 but they give you two extra blankets up but other than that the stay was nice we enjoyed our anniversary they upgraded our room stay too I love it we will be going back again

reviews.title: Not good this time
reviews.text: I like the grand. Usually good value for the money.  However this time...they checked me in a room that was not cleaned by house keeping.  Two days cold showers. Per the engineering staff the room temp can't go below 69 degrees because it freezes up the core. You were not able to adjust the room temp, had to have engineering keep adjusting it. "F".

reviews.title: Very good value for the money
reviews.text: The hotel is very close to Fremont street, only 5 minutes of walking.No breakfast but the breakfast is very good at the Magniola restaurant in the Queens hotel on Fremont street.Very noisy until 2am because of the music on Fremont street.Nice clean rooms but no coffee machine, no fridge and no micro wave.Very good price.Fast and automated check in and friendly staff.Free parking across the street.Fast internet.

reviews.title: The hidden gem of Las Vegas
reviews.text: I loved the strip and all the casinos. ALL has changed. The strip is bought by big money and you are just a number. The downtown grand is the real deal. Andrew the GM took time to chat with me and made me feel so appreciated. What a great place!

reviews.title: Weekend getaway
