reviews.text: We arrived at a very sketchy parking lot, but told ourselves, “This is normal for downtown area,” hoping our car would not get used as a beer pong table. Nice pile of feces going into the elevator. Brushed that off, and went to check-in. The room was clean, standard provisions provided for the price point paid. No fridge, but the front desk said we could have one for $15 per night. In the bathroom there was no division for the shower so the whole floor was a constant puddle, making it hard to use electronics like a hair dryer. I could not sleep much at all due to the constant bass coming through every wall and floor. This lasted well into the morning hours. It felt like a waking nightmare of sound torture. The room was located right above a major intersection on the fourth floor, making it so the patrons leaving the motorcycle bar across the street would have to stop there at the red light with their glorious engine sounds feeling like they were vibrating the whole building. In the morning, I headed out to my nail appointment, but the door hydraulics were not working 100% and it slammed shut, smashing two of my fingers between the door and the frame. I broke one finger and bruised the bone of the other, both are still unusable as they heal. Our group was supposed to have several tables reserved and the hotel decided it was too busy that night to honor the contract. Funny enough, the reason the floor was busy was because our group was there - which then left to gamble elsewhere.The second morning, we wanted to get brunch, so we went downstairs to the Freedom Café. After a little bit of a wait, we were sat at a table by the host. We waited, and waited, and waited, but never got service, not even a menu, so we left hungry. Thankfully, Pizza Rock is right across the street.Flash forward to check-out, and after a 30-minute wait, successfully checked out! Only to find we were over-charged on our resort fee, so we went back in line to resolve. We were told the total was correct. We said to please look again as we had a contracted rate. It was like pulling teeth to get help from this woman. After she conferred with her co-worker, we were told we could not be helped because we booked with a third-party. We asked who we could speak to that could help us, and were told the person was not in that day. We asked for their contact information and were told that the hotel would email them for us. After a week we got resolution.

reviews.title: Nice rooms in quiet downtown corner.
reviews.text: Checking in early with April was a rare treat in excellent customer service. She had us feeling good about our first ever downtown Vegas hotel stay. Then after depositing bags in the large, upgraded room we made the mistake of stopping at the Freedom Beat for late lunch to be basically ignored and then told by the bartender/host/order-taker that there was no cheese in the place other than blue? Right. Left when it seemed obvious that’s what the charming fella wanted. Oh well. April earned 5 stars. FBeat earned -1. Took off another star for checking out where they made an error on our bill and needed to be asked twice to check and correct it, confirmation of which didn’t come through for a few days. Enjoyed the casino, the discounted prime rib dinner was good, but sack breakfast after a long lineup, and no fridge in the room were negatives. Would stay again but lower expectations will make for a better stay.

reviews.title: Fantastic 30th anniversary getaway
reviews.text: First time staying downtown. Chose Downtown Grand after researching online. We picked a winner! Easy one-block walk to Fremont Street which offers a more laid-back, quiet and relaxing environment than the bigger casino hotels downtown. Perfect fit for us.Staff was great.  Jake greeted us at the front desk and accommodated us with an early check-in and an upgrade to the new Gallery Tower. The room was clean, comfortable and modern.Special shout out to craps dealer Steve T! His professional, outgoing and welcoming personality made my time on the craps table 100% enjoyable. Noriel was fantastic as well.Two suggestions to make a great property even better.1. More servers on the casino floor. It frequently took quite a while for a server to come around, then quite a while longer for drinks to arrive. Also, the mixed drinks were in tiny plastic cups (6-8 oz).2. My wife was really looking forward to an hour or two of pool time and sunshine Friday and Saturday. The number of free chairs were limited and taken. We were told the remaining sofas and cabanas required minimum food/drink spending of $300-$500. For a party of two who simply wanted to spend an hour or two at the pool that was a real disappointment. Also, the pool area should have umbrellas to offer shade for guests using chairs and sofas.Overall, we had a great time at the Downtown Grand and will definitely return.

reviews.title: Wouldnt Change a Thing!
reviews.text: I stayed here for about à week while I attended Crimecon. This was my second trip to Vegas feel Georgia (twice in just à few months!). My first stay was Fremont. I had a very early AM flight. I was in Vegas by 6, tired from a sleepless night. I rather hopelessly asked about an early check in, which was granted for $25 (well worth it!!! Heavy luggage for a solo female travler). I was given a free upgrade into the new tower (Gallery, I think?).  The room was BEAUTIFUL and spacious. It had a lot of natural lighting. Felt so welcoming. It made me feel great about being in Vegas! My stay was quiet, clean, comfortable and I felt safe during my entire trip. It was exactly what I'd hoped for. The hallways and rooms were modern and everything felt new. The bathrooms were great and the beds were copy. I would definitely consider à future stay here. I will send friends and family your way as well! Also, the pancakes from the bar downstairs are amazing!! Id eat them everyday if I could! 😅

reviews.title: Great location and comfortable stay Downtown
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed here for the Lovers and Friends festival, having been to Vegas before but never been ‘Downtown’ we chose this location to mix it up a bit. We were slightly nervous due to some of the reviews but honestly couldn’t have found it any better. We asked for a quiet room which we received, an internal facing one in the Gallery tower meaning the noise pollution from Fremont street which goes on until 3am didn’t bother us. Our room was spacious, clean, good lighting, nice bathroom. The staff were all really friendly, especially in the Freedom Beat bar which did a fab breakfast. Great location, super easy for Lyft rides to find you, minute walk to Fremont, good bar and pizza place opposite. We would definitely stay again and we usually stay at Caesers or the Wynn and honestly had such a good time here. Thanks!

reviews.title: Favorite in downtown LV
reviews.text: We've stayed here a couple of times now and it's our favorite in LV! Perfect location one block from Fremontstreet but a little outside the most busy areas. Spacious, comfy rooms, good rooftop pool, good breakfast, laid back atmosphere, also in casino. We hope to be back!

reviews.title: Rooms Are Nice But ………  NEVER AGAIN
reviews.text: The rooms were really nice and exceptionally clean I stayed in the newest tower. However they charge a resort fee and it doesn’t feel even remotely like you’re staying at a resort. Valet was not available on the day that I was there and only offered on the weekends. So there is a parking garage that is across the street that you have to lug all of your luggage across to the hotel. It is not in the nicest of neighborhoods they are transients and homeless people all around even inside of the parking structure. Not a good place for a lady or even a guy to walk out of or to at night. On top of that what is included in the resort fee is the garage which was not working properly and it didn’t function correctly given the parking pass they gave me. On top of that the elevators kept breaking down so I had to wait for engineering to fix it in order for me to get to the sixth floor unless I wanted to use the stairs. The Internet wasn’t working which is also a part of that resort fee. So I’m just curious how you don’t have a massage parlor or anything of the such that even resembles a resort but the things that you are charging that is covered underneath that resort fee aren’t even working but you still have the nerve to charge the fee. The key to your room is supposed to give you some sort of security even in the elevator so that people that are not staying there aren’t able to just hop on and get to any floor that wasn’t working either so anyone can hop on the elevator and go to any floor. I had a guy ask the person that I was with if he was with me and followed him up to the floor we were staying on and continue to ask him questions about me. I don’t know if they were trying to rob us and I don’t know if that guy was some type of trafficker  but it was quite scary. In the neighborhood at that hotel is in I would not put any of those things past the random guy asking those questions. Like I said the rooms are really nice and clean and the rate is really nice as well but you cannot place a dollar amount uncomfortability overall and safety. Last but not least as I was leaving the hotel for good there was a homeless person that was killed on the side of the hotel and the police were there at the crime scene as I was exiting.

reviews.title: Fun time
reviews.text: We were quite delighted to have stayed here. We got to gamble and not have to stray too far. Staff we encountered were all welcoming. We were there just to hang out with family and friends so it was very convenient.

reviews.title: Not for over 60 crowd
reviews.text: Not for over 60 crowd that wants to sleep at night. 3rd floor pool turns into an outdoor nightclub at night & the bam bam bam of the music lasts past midnight. We reserved a 2 queen room for 4 people & we only had 3 towels for 4 people. Their App to check-in did not work. Clerk at check-in should ask older guests if they are light sleepers & if so- automatically put them facing away from the pool. Felt bed was too soft. Hotel is dated & the smoke from the casino goes onto every floor and into the Grand tower- which is across the street! Old and ineffective black out curtains, no coffee maker, low grade soap & only 2 bottles of water! D/T the above & the massive homeless population in the surrounding area (urine soaked streets) - Next time -we will stay elsewhere. On the plus side- the young ladies working the coffee cafe were nice!

reviews.title: Great Hotel but beware of ATM in Casino
reviews.text: The premium hotel rooms in the Grand Tower are spacious and very comfortable. The Casino is not impressive. Beware of the ATM is you are a foreigner! We got $400 against a rate of €419 which is ridiculous. It should be between €379 and €390. The ATM is placed in a dark corner and the screenlight is dim. So our advice is to check the conversion rate very carefully!

reviews.title: Gaming only
reviews.text: Only went there after 10pm to play Blackjack 3 out of 4 nights.  All these dealers and Pit Boss were so friendly.  Place is slow at night during the week.  Really enjoyed the tables.  Good luck getting a drink if you are not on a table.  Service is slow on the floor.  At the bar there is one bartender who did not want to serve my sober self because I had to "put a $20 in the machine."  Well, please look here as I had $37.00 in credit- off my $20. Then I ask for a Tito's and water and she said, "We don't say Titos here."  OK- how do I know this?  Rude.  Not a fan.  Her tip went from an intended $5.00 to $1.00.  You can tell me not to say Titos, but don't be snarky. Place was dead and still had to wait forever for a drink.    If walking from Freemont day or night you will see people sleeping/resting/living on the street.  Just say hello.  Be kind.  They will not hurt you.

reviews.title: The Security Deposit Will Gets You Every Time, But Lower Resort Fee
reviews.text: This hotel is right in the middle of downtown Las Vegas, right next to Freemont street. The hotel rates are average for an off strip hotel, but they will slap a security deposit of $100 per night on you. I don't understand why security deposit  has to be per night, how many furniture can one breaks per night? I do like the lower resort fee than the strip hotels. Warning, don't get the rooms by the street, the 4th street facing the hotel is lined with bars and restaurants, and they play LOUD music at night like 12am at night. Get the room with an interactive Windows view, It's much more quiet....er. The room I have was clean and the bathroom have shower with no door to keep the water out, so the bathroom floor will be wet after a shower. The hotel café open until noon, the restaurant is not something to write home about. The casino is like any other mid-western casinos except you are in Vegas.

reviews.title: Decent, affordable casino near Fremont St
reviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights for a Las Vegas Conference Center event. It is a bit of a taxi/Uber or bus ride. But right by Fremont Street and plenty of restaurants. The casino is not big or overly fancy. Rooms are large, with desk, TV, good bathrooms. The bed was just ok...a bit hard. They have a white noise machine in the room, very nice.

reviews.title: Great as Usual
reviews.text: Love staying at Downtown Grand.  Clean rooms and great staff.  Casino is so much fun.  Bre at the Furnace Bar is an awesome bartender and takes care of everyone.My only complaint would be slow service at the pool, but I'm guessing that is a staffing issue like everywhere has.Will definitely stay again!

reviews.title: Winter Get Away
reviews.text: Stayed in the new Gallery  tower in mid February. I had no problem with the area.Thought the room was a good value. Only issue was the in room phone did not work and they could not fix it. No problem with the staff. Room was always clean.

reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text: Cesar was wonderful assisting with our party we had handicap guest and service here was very accommodating this was from checking in till checkout. The front desk ladies were very helpful as well.  Thank you Downtown Grand Hotel

reviews.title: Staying at the downtown Grand for the first time
reviews.text: April the front desk personnel was very wonderful and very professional and helped us out and got us checked in without any incidences. She was very good for what I observed when waiting for my coffee. Her supervisor needs to reward her for a job well done. The downtown Grand is blessed to have her as a personnel

reviews.title: not a friendly bunch
reviews.text: I will not step foot in a place that is rude and will treat their customers with no respect.  This place will only care about making money off you. They don't want to build a relationship. They could care less who you are and all they want is your money.

reviews.title: The SECRET jewel of old Downtown Las Vegas (Fremont Street area).  Best VALUE, by far, too!
reviews.text: This always-fresh first-class property is one short block off the main Fremont Street area.  The reason for the INCREDIBLY low prices, is that virtually nobody is aware that it exists.  They almost always have room specials on.  Their "Buy two nights, get one free" usually offers their best rate.I paid $45 for night one, $42 for night two, and my third night was FREE.  Also, this is no ordinary hotel.  It's the second-best Downtown, behind the recently opened Circa.  Of course at Circa, you'll pay 3 to 4X as much.  The rooms always look brand new and are always SPOTLESSLY clean.The casino here is a great deal, as well.  Five dollar blackjack is STILL often available.  Believe it or not, they also have a ONE dollar table.  Get there early in the day to get a seat!Get in on the SECRET, and you'll LOVE your stay here!

reviews.title: Long hike to rooms
reviews.text: The casino is nice but it's about a quarter of a mile to get to the rooms.  Located in a really skanky area.   The room was clean and large.  Nice hemp store just around the corner on  Fremont street.  Very skunky.

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Very nice quiet rooms. The casino is small and perfect along with a great little restaurant and bar inside with good food. Just a very short walk to Fremont street but don't get the noise. Also has a great morning coffee bar near the hotel lobby.

reviews.title: TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text: I just got off the phone with the rudest front desk employee named Jessica. It is approximately 1am on Saturday, April 9. I purposely waited late to call, so front desk wasn't too busy to answer my questions. I was asking her very simple questions about the different room types in the hotel as I haven't visited the hotel in over 7 years and a lot has changed since then. Originally I called and she picked up and then I said "Hello" and she hung up. Then I called back and she answered after 10 rings. She sounded very annoyed and told me to go on the website and everything was there. I told her that my specific questions were not answered on the site. She continued to talk over me and rudely insist I go on the website instead of just answering me. Then I asked if I could speak to someone else because of her impatience and lack of helpfulness.  She stated noone else was there with her. Then I proceeded to ask her about price points, she said that's what reservations deals with, and totally dismisses me. I WAS going to book a week at DOWNTOWN GRAND, but if I'm going to be treated the way Jessica just treated me, I'd rather give my money to ANY other hotel!!! She needs to be re-trained or let go.

reviews.title: Great place to stay in downtown Las Vegas
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed for a three night stay in March 2022.  I researched many hotels in the downtown area.  We wanted to be near Freemont Street, stay close, but away from the noise.  The Downtown Grand delivers.  We stayed on the sixth floor in the gallery tower and did not hear any noise from Freemont Street.  Our room was very nice and had everything we needed.  (I would've preferred to have a mini fridge but they charge $15 per night for one) .  We enjoyed the casino, they do have one table that has $1 blackjack.  The table was always busy and you have to be patient to get an open seat.  The dealers are awesome!   They only had one waitress for the entire casino but we stayed during the week so she came around quite often since the casino was not that busy.  We played both the $1 and $5 blackjack tables.  We would love to visit downtown again and play to stay at the Downtown Grand again!

reviews.title: Great find just off of Fremont Street
reviews.text: First night stop off a two day trip for concert. Wanted something on our near Fremont Street but hotels on Fremont are a little tired and loud. Found this nice surprise while looking for place to stay. Large king bed room in the Grand Tower. Room was amazing, spacious, and large comfy king bed. Close to Fremont Street. Mob Museum is across the street.The Freedom Beat Café was a bit of a disappointment but won’t stop from staying again and already planning to stay again.  Plenty of slot machines and a small selection of table games but adequate. Staff was great and all we encountered were great!

reviews.title: Mrs.
reviews.text: Super Clean room, complementary waters, not most places do that, Also April at  front desk was really nice and had great costumer service , she helped us check in and check out and always with a smile , we will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Awesome Check-In
reviews.text: April at the front desk made the check-in process so smooth and easy. She was very professional, approachable and knowledgeable. She reminded me of some of the perks that came w/my reservation through my silver membership w/hotels.com which was very helpful and made our stay awesome!

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: I was assisted with my by April who was welcoming, polite and helpful. She identified that I was a returning guest and a premier guest! She searched for and upgraded my room and was altogether a delight!

reviews.title: Will Never Stay Here Again
reviews.text: The pictures online were one part of the hotel.  The part we stayed in, looked nothing like the pictures.  It was old and smelly.  The room decor was tacky and super outdated.  It was nice to have 2 bathrooms in our suite but would have been even nicer had one of the showers not taken literally 5 minutes for the water to get hot.  The lines at check-in were long and slow moving at all hours so if you needed anything from the front desk, you needed to give yourself an additional 20 mins.  The hotel brags that it is 100% non smoking except it's not.  Maybe it's only limited to the casino but the ventilation is so bad that the entire hotel reeks of smoke.  There is no store on premisis so nowhere to purchase water, snacks, toiletries....I learned my lesson about straying from the usual places we stay and would never recommend this property to anyone.

reviews.title: Bachelorette!
reviews.text: Exactly what we were looking for: affordable, fun, clean, and surprisingly good food!  The customer service was exceptional from the second of arrival to leaving, not kidding, actually amazing, from the reception staff, the room service, the pool employees – like amazing!Such spacious suites also, we could have easily cramped more girls in the rooms that we did. Great everything.

reviews.title: Pick Another Hotel - Terrable
reviews.text: From the start the check out n was a disaster. AJ was the worst at check in did not care and was rude. The process to check in and then to check out could not have been slower. It took almost 2 hours combined. Housekeeping almost never came to clean the room and left on occasions no towels! Lots of choices in the area pick another hotel.

reviews.title: Mediocre at Best
reviews.text: Rude check-in and waitstaff at the restaurant next to check-in. If Watson is at the desk you want to talk to him vs a counterpart. He's the best. Rooms are basic and just okay. They'll try to charge you $15/day for a fridge. No coffee maker. No hairdryer.Beds slide off the frames. Stay at the Golden Nuggett Instead.

reviews.title: Terrible loud music till 3am
reviews.text: We have been staying at different hotels for over 20 years,  downtown and on the strip.  This hotel was the loudest ever, super loud music till 3am.  The pool closed at 5, so why am i paying a resort fee.  I know it's Vegas and there is always loud noise, but this was terrible when you have to get up early.  Be aware if getting up early music doesn't start till about 10:30.

reviews.title: Modern, clean, great!
reviews.text: Modern, clean, quiet with all amenities in the room I wish to have. Missed room service a bit tho. Staff was friendly and checkin was smooth. The rooms must be recently refurbed as everything was brand spaking new. Will stay here again if needed.

reviews.title: Would stay here again
reviews.text: Close to Fremont Street and the Mob Museum. The room was nice but there was no mini fridge, microwave or coffee maker. The outdoor pool area looked beautiful from our room. This was our first time staying downtown and we would stay here again.

reviews.title: Okay hotel. Noisy
reviews.text: The check in was a bit slow. They said they just changed the computer system. The front desk staff were nice. However, if you are parking at the self park, you have to get the ticket from the garage first before they will give you the parking pass. It wasted an extra 10 min of my time. I don’t know why they didn’t just give the pass to people who are staying upfront. The hotel room is old. There is a newer part but I got the old Grand tower. Maybe the newer part would be a better experience. It’s not clear on the website which room is in which building (depending on where you book it from). The non smoking room smelled weird. Then there’s intermittent smoke smell coming through during the stay. There were strands of hair on the bathroom floor. The water drained slowly from the bathtub and sink. The room was large. The bed was fairly comfortable. The outlets at the desk don't work well - the plugs would slide/fall out after being plugged in. The WiFi was good and fast. The outside noise was the worst part of the stay. There was an outdoor concert. It was loud even on a very high floor and went on until 2 am on a weekday!! There’s a white noise machine in the room but the bass was too loud for it to be useful. The self parking garage is scary, dirty and smells. Be warned and not leave valuables in there. If you had a choice between staying at the Strip versus downtown Vegas, I strongly suggest the Strip.

reviews.title: Excellent customer service
reviews.text: The customer service was amazing. We stayed in the new tower and it was beautiful. You really get a great deal. The hotel is very close to Fremont street do there is a ton to do, and the best part is that it’s not super loud. The location is excellent. Lots of food options.  The  Hotel and casino does not smell like smoke! Thank God! Osciel was excellent 10/10

reviews.title: Clean rooms great atmosphere
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at the Downtown Grand. Just a block off of Freemont St. So it wasn't so congested. Staff extremely friendly. Rooms in the Gallery Tower modern and clean. The food at the restaurant was good and reasonably priced.  Highly recommend and would stay here again.

reviews.title: Hotel discriminates against mentally disabled persons
reviews.text: For those of you requiring travel with an ESA/PSD service animals, be advised the hotel does not recognize mental disabilities and will charge you $50 plus tax for your pet.  I was told by the manager it is due to their independent "hotel policy" and was forced to sign a document acknowledging their unlawful policy in order for the dog to stay with me and also could not cancel the same day reservation without penalty.  After explaining to the manager the policy was in violation with the Americans with Disability Act, Fair Housing Act and Nevada Disability Laws (NRS 426.325), I took it a step further and offered to show him my ESA/PSD documentation, even though it was well within my rights not to disclose them, as a means to prove I was not lying to the hotel about having a service animal, and was told "it did not matter" because hotel policy doesn't recognize them.I have submitted the violation to the DOJ Civil Rights Division in the meantime I would highly recommend you to spend your money elsewhere.

reviews.title: Close to Freemont
reviews.text: We were very pleased with this hotel and casino.  The room was great, the food was great, and the casino had cheaper priced table games than the strip.  We could actually play a $5 crap table!!  The people at the hotel and casino were super nice and friendly.  The room was clean and the casino was clean.  The hotel is just off Fremont street which is nice.  At least from the room we were in, we could hear the base from the music.  They did provide a sound machine thing in the room.  It helped, possibly should bring ear plugs or head phones if you can't sleep with the base sound.  The room did not have a refrigerator but we did not ask for one.  There is a safe in the room.We enjoyed our stay so much we are coming back in the spring.  Would recommend this hotel to others.Masks were required for all people regardless of vaccination status.  But that was everywhere in Vegas when we were there.  Dec. 2021

reviews.title: Lack luster
reviews.text: King size bed was barely a queen. Breakfast was supposed to start at 6 and didn’t open till 8. Charged when should of been free. Let customer service know. Didn’t offer anything accept a “sorry for the inconvenience” text. A lot of choices in Vegas, would of been easy to remedy with a comp.

reviews.title: Great room, close to Fremont
reviews.text: Started off great with a friendly check-in from Angel. Got to be in a new tower room. Very nice and stylish. Hotel is very close to Fremont Street Experience, which is exactly what I wanted. Free breakfasts included. Parking is a block away, which is a bit inconvenient with luggage, but there is valet parking

reviews.title: Good hotel.
reviews.text: Nice stay at the downtown grand. Room was good, nice and clean. Housekeeping was helpful and kind. April at the front desk did a great job helping us check in and sorting out the exact room that was best for us. She really nailed the selection. Thanks!

reviews.title: Great Service by Ruby
reviews.text: Staying at the Downtown Grand and needed some help with the guest WIFI. Ruby at the front desk was a big help and goty wofe and I set up on a jiffy and then showed us how to get logged in again if needed. Thanks

reviews.title: Christmas family vacation
reviews.text: Really nice hotel extremely friendly staff, Jerrick was awesome! Everything you need is available in this hotel. Casino, restaurants and bar. Close walking distance to many of other attractions. Great!!

reviews.title: Great Staff and Accommodations
reviews.text: We had a large group meeting in November (2021) for a number of days. The staff led by Jennifer Scott went beyond being courteous and allowed our stay to accomplish it’s mission, to reach the under-served in the nearby area. The rooms were well maintained and they were very flexible in allowing us to conduct meetings and even materially contributing to the effort. Bless you all!

reviews.title: Gallery   Tower Corner RM3403 was clean and large
reviews.text: Came for the Rodeo and had a Great time at DTG...we have been here before but never stayed at the Newer Tower....Gallery Tower rooms are Cleaner and Newer...Ms. April checked us in and recommended the corner rooms....She was efficient and very friendly.....Corner room 3403 had a view of The Mob Museum, mountains and Main Street Casino lights....Ms. April gave us a FREE late check out, since we were there for my B-day!!!  We ate breakfast at the cafe (next to Lobby) and Triple George, (pricey but very good service and meal)... Only downside, was the Gambler Grill, no wait staff ...You had to order at the bar and Howard would cook, serve and bus the table.....One hard working employee with good personality! Finally, we felt very safe at DTG and only less than 100 yards to Fremont Experience...Also, won 500 bucks on the Slots....We will Return

reviews.title: Off Fremont Street, but a good bet.
reviews.text: One block off Fremont Street. Right across street from Mob Museum.  Older hotel but they've kept it up nice.  The casino is small but the staff is very friendly.  Jake and Watson at the front desk were very helpful.  Room was very nice, very comfortable.  Valet staff was very great and helpful.

reviews.title: Gray first impression
reviews.text: April was awesome! She was quick and helpful. Very friendly. Some of the best front desk service I have received in Vegas. We got an early check in as well. Great way to start the trip! We can’t wait to go explore Fremont!

reviews.title: DTG ROCKS
reviews.text: Hello to the reader of this review. Hands down DTG is the place to stay in LasVegas. My husband and I have been coming to Las Vegas for 7 years, typically a few times a year. 4 years ago we found this place. Simply put, we never stay anywhere else. The list of reasons why is too long to list. The high level version…. intimate atmosphere, super clean and the the best part is the staff/employees. We stay for a week and rarely find ourselves outside of the 4 walls of this wonderful casino. When you are here make sure to say hi to Eleanor who works in the pit, she is welcoming and genuinely loves her customers.

reviews.title: Not the best welcome I've ever had
reviews.text: After I checked in, I went up to my room, sat on the bed, and felt something. I lifted the sheet and found a used condom under the sheets. I went downstairs, pulled the manager aside, and informed him. I said that I was going out to eat, and when I got back I'd appreciate it if the condom was removed, and all new sheets and pillow cases were put on the bed. I returned a while later and saw that housekeeping had just straightened out the sheets I had pulled back (to, you know, make sure there wasn't anything else on the mattress that shouldn't be there) without even bothering to tuck them in. I lifted the sheet and saw that the condom was still there. I went back downstairs, told the manager, said I'd throw the thing out myself, if he could just have someone bring me fresh sheets and pillow cases. A little while later, housekeeping brought me four flat sheets, no fitted sheet, no pillow cases. I called down, spoke to the manager, and asked if someone could please bring up fresh pillow cases. They did. I unfurled the sheets, saw that one had what appeared to be a cigarette burn on it, and the other had stains in the corner, as if from coffee (I hope it was just coffee). I was exhausted when I arrived and had to prepare for a conference the next day, otherwise I would have left. The rest of the stay was uneventful, perhaps because I left a Do Not Disturb sign on my door for the next three days.

reviews.title: Valet
reviews.text: Last night I used the valet. All the team from when I left my car and when I picked it up. They were super friendly and helpful.  When I came out of the hotel. I was immediately greeted by Alex  who was very polite and took speedy care of me.Great customer service

reviews.title: Bartender
reviews.text: Always great service!!…Pedro and Monica are always very attentive and friendly, always recommend the bar at the grand, great service, delicious drinks, and always get lucky in the machines playing Leno…Forget the other casinos this is the casino to be while visits if downtown Vegas!!

reviews.title: Hi bro
reviews.text: Monica and Pedro were Amazing! Great service as we played machines and hung out having a blast!  It was so much fun. We love the Grand. We will always come here and we will always ask for our favorite cocktail server and bartender!!!!

reviews.title: Disappointing stay
reviews.text: This was our 3rd time at this hotel and we have always  spoken very highly of it but not this time. We had a premium king room and had to call maintenence out as soon as we checked in because half of the lights didn't work. Paul came and sorted this for us, he was very helpful and pleasant to chat with. The room was supposed to be none smoking but had a very strong smell of stale smoke. Paul arranged for a air purifier to be put in the room which helped for the 30 minutes it was there.  The bed linen didn't fit the beds so you would wake in the morning with the sheets hanging off the bed. The room was not cleaned well, I wrote my initials in the dust on the lamp, the carpet was heavily stained and there were marks all down the wall where some liquid had been spilt. I didn't want to be in the room any longer than I had to be, it was not a room I could relax in.  Upon check out we again expressed our dissatisfaction about the room, mainly the strong odour. The lady at check out explained there is nothing they can do about the smell but people should not smoke on that floor. She suggested next time we book the new tower as the smoking in that tower is policed much more. We also showed pictures of the filth in the room as I didn't want to appear to be complaining for no reason. They knocked off one night resort fee, which was pretty insulting. We left this hotel and checked into a suite at the Bellagio which was like heaven. We will not stay at this hotel again which I feel disappointed about as we like to spend time downtown. Circa will be our next spot.

reviews.title: Title
reviews.text: Jodi at the bar and Michael at player services are great!!!   She makes one of the best bloody Mary’s I’ve ever had. Michael was was so informative and nice. Made the players card so easy to get. I’ll be back

reviews.title: Best room and services
reviews.text: I should start with the room but . . Jodi at the center bar was amazing and one of the best bloody Mary’s I’ve had. Michael from player services suggested a card and was so simple to do. Very informative as well. The rooms here were awesome. We checked in a tad late and managed to get an upgrade to a non smoking room. Love this place.

reviews.title: Best Service !
reviews.text: We frequent here a lot! We bring family, eat here at the cafe. Have a great time and the best part is that when we need a room fast or great service.We are always working with Jennifer Lawhorn. As we travel a lot and she is very attentive to our needs! Don’t think your service is undervalued we truly do appreciate the stays and assistance! It’s always a good time to bring family and enjoy a time in Vegas! Thanks again ! Jermaine SteeleAllRoadsLeadhere.Com

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: We loved the service at the bar from Jodi and Pedro. Hotel was nice and clean and bed was comfortable. Drinks are great and location is amazing to drive Freemont and restaurants. I would definitely stay here again. Came for a football game and was really easy to get a cab .

reviews.title: I Love the Grand!
reviews.text: I love the Grand because it is small enough to find your friends and close to many other casinos for a change of pace.  The pool is very comfortable and the rooms are always clean with good showers.  Beds and pillows are first class and comfy as can be.  Elevators are fast and restaurants are very good.  Free parking across the street.  Downtown isn’t for everyone but I love the old Vegas feel

reviews.title: Best hotel in Las Vegas *****
reviews.text: We have been coming to Las Vegas for more than 30 years now and finally found the best hotel. We have tried every hotel on the strip and nothing can compete to where we just stayed. THE DOWNTOWN GRAND HOTEL & CASINO. This is the best hotel in Las Vegas. You can chuck all other hotels out of the window, even the 5-star ones. This hotel has so much more to offer, like super clean rooms, a small, but exciting casino, great food and people that care about the guests. The staff are just unbelievable and will go out of the way to help you and explain everything too you. AJ checked us in and was so fantastic, she took the time to explain everything to us. It was also my husband's Birthday and AJ upgraded us to a one-bedroom Jr suite. Our friends who came to Vegas to help celebrate were staying at the Four Queens and we invited them over for a small pizza party on the first night were so impressed with our room, that they want us to book for them the next time we go. All I have to say to DOWNTOWN GRAND HOTEL & CASINO is, keep up the good work and we will be back. REAL SOON. Our friends and family will also be joining us.        Thank you, DOWNTOWN GRAND. We look forward to many more visits to the best hotel in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel. Need to work on Cleanliness.
reviews.text: When we arrived there was an empty Monster can on the desk. And the hand soap was used and the wrapper was on the counter. The carpets were very stained, especially around the foot of the bed, looked like red juice. When we woke up the first morning, there was a dirty sock in our sheets, that wasn't ours.  When I hopped in bed the first night, i noticed the bottom sheet was rolled up at the end. I did not receive the ANGEL App. I called and the front desk said they would reconfigure it.  I never did get it.  I called about needing Kleenex and about the sock.  They did remake the bed and get us Kleenex. Loved the Freedom Beat restaurant.  Food was perfect. Gerardo was awesome!

reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.text: It was decent and clean. Over priced. Off Fremont Street which is a positive because Fremont Street was really noisy. Rooms are OK but dated.  Definitely nothing special about the place. I think it’s fine but it definitely wouldn’t be my first choice.

reviews.title: This place really has its act together
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised by every aspect of my three- night stay at this hotel just off Freemont St. Outstanding check-ins, continental breakfast (included in my package) was better than expected, rooms were clean and generally well appointed (if you can ignore the absence of a fridge, micro or coffee-maker. Just far enough off Freemont for a decent night's sleep but a minute away from the action. Had less of a "factory" feel than some of the others.  Good value!  Could have used better lighting.

reviews.title: Josh at Players Club was super awesome!!
reviews.text: Josh was extremely nice and very helpful at the Players Club booth to get us set up with our rewards cards. Love staying at the Downtown Grand! Love the location and free parking. Thank you for another great stay!

reviews.title: Noisy and watch for the upcharges
reviews.text: I booked this hotel over the phone after I had researched it online. The rate was a suite room with continental breakfast. we went to bed around 2 am after we played all night and the noise in the room was so loud the window was shacking! I called the desk several times before someone would answer. They had several complaints and moved me to a interior room on the same floor and told me they would remove the resort fee, the noise was still so bad we didn't sleep. I explained this to the front desk and they just shrugged. we then went for continental breakfast and they charged it to my room she said they will take it off after checkout. They did not take it off. after complaining for two days in a row they removed the resort fee and the deposit not the continental breakfast. This hotel is not worth the money they charge as a travel agent I do not recommend this place at all.

reviews.title: Don't Stay Here Unless You Like to Party All Nigjt
reviews.text: This is my first time staying downtown and its one big party that extends inside your hotel room. The first room I checked into shaked from the music outside which can go on to 4 AM. I went back downstairs to get earplugs (which they have at the front desk) and begged for another room. Yerika was kind enough to give me one in the Gallery Tower which is much nicer and quieter (although they were drilling in the next room at 7:00 AM). The star is for Yerrika since I would not have survived this visit without her.

reviews.title: not recommended
reviews.text: The rooms are nice... the hotel is nice...But the noise from Freemont is way too loud for anyone who is trying to get a good nights rest.. the music goes on until at least 2am nightly.  Definitely do not recommend this place.. if you're trying to get some sleep. Also,  the parking garage across the street is disgusting...reeks of urine, and is covered in broken glass.. absolutely disgusting. I won't be staying there anymore... only because of the loud music ...i can honestly say...i did not get any restful sleep the time i was there... not good.

reviews.title: Birthday
reviews.text: Michael S and Jodi are the BEST/ We visit every year and Michael has gone “overboard “ with niceness and service. Jodi is always friendly and welcomes you back. We’re here for a 70th birthday party. Michael is awesome.

reviews.title: Vegas Trip
reviews.text: Jodi and Lena at the Veil Bar were fantastic!!They were always smiling.  Our suite Was fantastic the games were fun thanks so much   Everyone was very nice the bathrooms were clean the hallways were cleaning the pool look beautiful the lobby was great

reviews.title: Worth the stay
reviews.text: My husband and I are regular travelers and also enjoy Vegas often.  This is the first time we've stayed here and we will definitely stay again.   We stayed in the deluxe king.  Beds were comfy, rooms were clean.  There was water to drink (that didn't cost you at all), a hair dryer (nice one) and lots of room.  The casino is small and there are no table games on Wednesday's (bummer), however they have some great restaurants and you ate only a block off Fremont with table games galore.   The pool was 100% amazing.   Great space, open and lots of sun.  I was disappointed that it closed so early though, but it is October,  so there is that.  Overall I highly recommend a stay in this property.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Close to everything!
reviews.text: This place is a solid four! I thought the hotel was clean and well-maintained and the service was outstanding. My only complaint is the hot water wasn’t exactly hot , more like lukewarm, so I didn’t get the hottest shower there. It was within walking distance to everything downtown and there are wonderful food selections right by the hotel. I didn’t have any luck at the hotel casino, but I would definitely say it was a great stay for the price!

reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text: Brenda keeps the casino floor looking spotless!  One of the sanitizer stations were empty, I saw Brenda on the floor and asked her if someone can please refill the station.  Within minutes Brenda was back with a refill.  She always greets me with a smile and treats me like family every time I am there.  You can see Brenda is a team player always helping out others.  Thank you for always helping me out Brenda!

reviews.title: Guest
reviews.text: Noise level from the outside is ridiculous . Loud music played  pass 2:00 a.m each night . If you are planning on sleeping , you  will not be able to ! The music is very loud . Good luck on trying to get some sleep !

reviews.title: Good stay at the downtown grand hotel
reviews.text: Good hotel in the Downtown area of Las Vegas. They were able to deal with my changing accomodation plans and were always polite.I especially liked the breakfast bar (and service by Jessica Noriega) at the "Art Bar".The pool was ok, but not my kind of place for a business trip. Free WiFi at 10mbps and car parking as well

reviews.title: The place to stay for Punk Rock Bowling
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for 2021 Punk Rock Bowling. Location wise, it is a little dumpy.  There is a lot of homeless folks. Fremont Street is nearby, which we found filled with annoying people and isn’t much better than walking through Times Square in NYC. You are a good deals away from the actual Las Vegas Strip, so you are best to have a car if you are wanting to travel around. The hotel itself wasn’t bad. It actually worked well for PRB. Our room was actually quite pleasant. Lots of space, good AC, comfy bed, decent shower and bathroom. The casino itself is small compared to other casinos in the area. The hotel was fairly clean.  They have free parking across the street in the garage. We had no issues with the garage and going in and out, but it was dirty and had homeless sleeping throughout. The patio and pool area is a cool setting. Some of the punk bands played there during the noon timeframe of the weekend.  I would stay here again for Punk Rock Bowling. Not sure if I would stay here otherwise.

reviews.title: Las vegas
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at the grand our daughter was getting married Jennifer the casino host was very friendly very courteous  The hotel room was clean and nice she went out of her way to make sure we had a nice time Their restaurant across the street triple George was the most awesome meal that we ate the whole time we were there

reviews.title: Staff is AWESOME!!
reviews.text: Whenever I come to Vegas I more times then not will stay at DTG, just in the surface the location is perfect, minuted to walk to freemont, several great eateries, fun stuff to do! That being said, the main reason I stay at DTG is becaue JAKE FRANQUEZ, the Front Desk Manager, that young man goes above an beyond to insure our stay is as enjoyable as it can be, his staff is a reflection of his can do personality and they always do whatever needs to be done to make the stay AWESOME!! We will be back soon amd we will stay at DOWNTOWN GRAND, we hope to see Jake!

reviews.title: Evening out
reviews.text: Had a blast at the downtown grand this week.  Jodi, Tara, Hector and Pedro at the bar were fantastic!  The drinks were exactly as requested and the gaming was friendly as well.  They do drawings for regular players as well as fantastic dining options

reviews.title: Absolutely Horrible!!!
reviews.text: Pictures are nothing, and I mean NOTHING like they are online. My first room had a broken shower head and shower bench which would not lift up and does not show in any picture you see online. We were moved to a new room and the shower was just as nasty, it looked like the curtain had never been changed. My bedding was gross, whatever bedding there was. I am beyond unimpressed. I do not recommend this hotel. Spend the same amount and get yourself a nicer place.

reviews.title: Fremont Street Experience
reviews.text: The Downtown Grand was a block from the Fremont Street Experience. Easy to locate the hotel and parking was conveniently close.  Parking was complimentary. Room was clean and the casino small but lucky.  We stayed on the 7th Floor and of course you could hear the noise from the music on Fremont Strip but it quiets down after midnight.The pool area is really nice with a bar area but it was a little cool the day we stayed to swim.Checked in around 4:30 and only one other person in line. No wait for the Bellman taking the luggage to the room and also picking it up at 7:00 a.m.  Express checkout was a plus, just drop the room keys in the slot by front desk.We would definitely stay at the Downtown Grand Hotel on our next trip to Vegas.

reviewsWithMentions.title: Stephen at front desk was truly a superstars
reviewsWithMentions.text: Wow! When I talk about incredible service this is probably the best and most helpful service I have experienced throughout my entire stay in the U.S, I was greeted by Stephen who took care of everything and even noticed it was my birthday, he put us on the highest floor and even provided us with the opportunity to upgrade. His service was the kind of experience you witness celebrities deal with in movies he was just incredible! We will 100% be back.The hotel itself is located at the end of Fremont street if you want to party and have a good time then this is the perfect location Fremont street has tones to do there’s so many live music options and bars and casinos around it’s really incredible! The music stops at 3am be mindful if you’re a family you will hear the attractions until 3am but nothing a little white noise can’t cancel out. The amenities in the hotel are really awesome! The grand tower studio suite is really beautiful! I struggled to find YouTube reviews on it but it was really just a dream. If you need a microwave it’s $15 a night and if you want transport the deuces bus is around the corner and is about $8 for the entire day/night.The Bellagio etc is a 15 min drive in a taxi or about 25/28 mins on the bus! Overall the hotel is very well priced, great amenities there is also free parking and the service from Stephen and if his colleagues are anything like him is a 10/10! Really great experience for our first time as Australians over to Vegas!
